paras_en: Raytronic Technology (7812‑TW) officially listed today (22nd), trading under its core millimeter‑wave and phased‑array antenna technology. Its products have been sold to more than 35 countries worldwide and it has accumulated over 140 global patents, covering 5G/6G, satellite communications, aerospace defense, and automotive radar.

However, Raytronic Technology (7812‑TW) still faces delays from telecom operators in deploying millimeter‑wave, longer verification periods for satellite and aerospace defense, and its operating scale has not yet expanded, resulting in accumulated losses. Therefore, what truly matters after the IPO is not the technology theme but whether the satellite, FWA, and defense projects can move from verification and small‑scale shipments into mass production, pushing revenue past the break‑even threshold.
(Image source: You Analysis Industry Database)

Instrument equipment gross margins exceed 70%, modules become the second growth curve. Raytronic Technology (7812‑TW) currently has two main product lines: instrument equipment and antenna modules. Instrument equipment has been laid out since 2018, accumulating over 2,200 customers across more than 34 countries, mainly serving research institutions, telecom R&D units, and system integrators.

The company says instrument equipment revenue can maintain double‑digit growth, with gross margins above 70%, which is the main foundation supporting operations at present. As global communication technology moves toward 6G and FR3 bands, telecom operators, research institutions, and equipment vendors are simultaneously increasing demand for millimeter‑wave R&D and measurement. The company will continue to expand its test equipment lineup and deepen cooperation with international instrument giants to broaden its overseas customer base and sales scale.

The second growth curve is the millimeter‑wave array antenna module. The company uses a CloverCell modular architecture to increase part commonality across different products. Currently, the unit commonality ratio is about 30% to 40%, shortening development time for customized products and reducing costs through procurement scale. In addition, the company combines Taiwan’s packaging, PCB, and EMS supply chain, introducing AiP antenna packaging technology to prepare for subsequent mass production.

However, as antenna modules gradually increase in volume, the product mix will also become a key factor affecting gross margins: commercial 5G, 6G, and automotive modules have larger shipment volumes with gross margins of about 10% to 30%; satellite and defense products, while smaller in shipment volume, have higher unit prices and technical thresholds, achieving gross margins of 30% to 50%.

The company’s long‑term goal is to maintain an overall average gross margin above 40%. Therefore, in addition to observing whether antenna modules can be successfully scaled up, attention should also be paid to the shipment share of different applications and the impact of commercial module scaling on overall gross margin.
(Image source: You Analysis Industry Database)
Three projects awaiting mass production, verification schedule determines the speed of loss improvement. The projects with clearer progress are three:

1. Satellite: Raytronic collaborates with North American modem manufacturer Comtech to develop the "One Modem, One Antenna" multi‑orbit satellite terminal. The product has undergone end‑to‑end testing on various satellite systems and plans to advance to mass production with an EMS partner this year.

2. 5G/6G: The company, along with customers and Taiwanese ODMs, is developing an FWA wireless return solution. The system integration is nearly complete, and the next step is field testing at the customer site. The company is optimistic about the market potential of millions of deployments, but actual orders still depend on test results and customer implementation timelines.
3. Defense: The company has shipped a small quantity to a Middle Eastern customer for preliminary verification. Production will only begin after successful verification.

In other words, although the three businesses have all passed the early R&D stage, the next key factor is whether customer verification can be completed smoothly and further transition into scaled shipments.

Therefore, the most important verification for Raytronic Technology (7812‑TW) after the IPO is whether the satellite terminal can be put into mass production as planned, whether FWA can complete field testing, and whether the defense project can transition from small shipments to formal orders. If any one of these enters mass production, revenue growth could exceed the original double‑digit level; however, with a long verification period and uncertain mass‑production timing, the speed of loss convergence remains the core observation indicator.

items.title_en: Value Investing: Latest Industry Research Report – Hwa Shin Technology (2492-TW) August Revenue Hits New High, Murata’s Capacity Adjustment Opens Order‑Switching Opportunities
paras: 華新科 (2492-TW)8月營收再往上走，單月達45.69億元，月增2.8%、年增45.54%，創94個月新高。前八月累計營收299.41億元，年增22.1%。7月營收明顯跳升後，8月仍能續增，顯示訂單已持續轉成實際出貨，也讓這次研究重點從先前的訂單出貨比，推進到供給結構與轉單變化。
華新科 (2492-TW)的產品組合以積層陶瓷電容為主，占營收約42%；晶片電阻約22%，射頻元件約17%，其餘為圓板電容等產品。這套產品線橫跨伺服器、網通、車用、工業與消費電子。人工智慧伺服器拉高高容值、耐高溫與小尺寸料號需求，成熟產品則受到日韓廠重新分配產能影響，華新科 (2492-TW)同時站在高階需求成長與成熟料號轉單兩條路徑上。
公司訂單能見度已到年底，部分產品延伸至明年，訂單出貨比由前一季約1.4升至1.8。人工智慧伺服器使用的積層陶瓷電容數量遠高於一般伺服器，規格也更集中在小尺寸、高容值與耐高溫產品。這些料號會消耗更多有效產能，高階產線吃緊後，原本供應消費與車用市場的產能也會被間接排擠。
近期村田調整部分積層陶瓷電容產品線，涵蓋若干消費與車用成熟料號，資源轉向附加價值較高的人工智慧產品。相關料號仍有一段轉換期，影響卻已提前反映在客戶重新認證與尋找第二供應商。華新科 (2492-TW)具備積層陶瓷電容和晶片電阻的完整產能，產品又已進入多種終端應用，承接成熟料號轉單的條件比單一產品廠商完整。
中國積層陶瓷電容市場近期出現新的分工。人工智慧造成日韓廠縮減部分消費規產能，國際筆電品牌與代工廠加快驗證中國記憶體及被動元件供應商，中國廠在中低階料號的接單空間擴大；高階伺服器產品仍仰賴日韓廠的技術與良率。華新科 (2492-TW)在東莞大朗設有生產基地，能貼近中國客戶，又可用台灣與馬來西亞產能服務全球供應鏈，這種跨區配置有利於接住重新分配的訂單。
供給重新配置也讓報價環境轉強。產業資料顯示，日韓大廠已陸續調整第四季價格，台灣與中國供應商的部分積層陶瓷電容報價也開始上移。原料、人力與擴產成本同步增加，華新科 (2492-TW)已表達調價方向，後續要觀察通路端漲價能否擴散到直接客戶，以及高階料號的產品組合改善能否持續反映在營收。
華新科 (2492-TW)今年資本支出提高到30至40億元，今、明兩年規畫各增加約10%產能。晶片電阻擴產集中在馬來西亞與東莞大朗，積層陶瓷電容以高雄和大朗為主，兩地產能利用率已在高檔。公司先備妥廠房空間，再導入設備與認證，可縮短新增產能開出的時間，承接人工智慧規格與成熟料號轉單。
8月營收續創波段高點，配合村田調整成熟料號、日韓廠轉向人工智慧產品，華新科 (2492-TW)的成長來源比8月初更清楚。研究重點放在月營收能否維持高檔、訂單出貨比與能見度、直接客戶的調價進度、中國市場轉單，以及高雄、大朗和馬來西亞新產能的量產節奏。這些指標只要接續落實，營運仍有向上延伸的空間。

paras_en: Hwa Shin Technology (2492‑TW) saw August revenue climb again to NT$4.569 billion, up 2.8% month‑over‑month and 45.54% year‑over‑year, marking a 94‑month peak. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$29.941 billion, a 22.1% annual increase. After a sharp jump in July, August’s continued growth shows that orders are being converted into actual shipments, shifting the research focus from order‑to‑shipment ratios to supply‑chain structure and order‑switch dynamics.

The company’s product mix is dominated by multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), which account for about 42% of revenue; chip resistors make up roughly 22%, RF components about 17%, with the remainder coming from round‑lead capacitors and other items. These lines span servers, networking, automotive, industrial and consumer electronics. AI‑driven servers boost demand for high‑capacitance, high‑temperature and miniaturized parts, while mature products are affected by Japanese and Korean manufacturers reallocating capacity, placing Hwa Shin on two growth paths: high‑end AI demand and mature‑part order switches.

Order visibility now extends to year‑end, with some products reaching into next year, and the order‑to‑shipment ratio has risen from about 1.4 in the prior quarter to 1.8. AI servers use far more MLCCs than typical servers, favoring small‑size, high‑capacitance and high‑temperature specifications. These parts consume more effective capacity, so once the high‑end lines are tight, capacity previously serving consumer and automotive markets will be indirectly squeezed.

Recently, Murata adjusted several MLCC product lines, pulling some consumer and automotive mature parts and shifting resources toward higher‑value AI products. The affected parts are in a transition phase, but the impact is already evident as customers re‑qualify components and seek second sources. Hwa Shin (2492‑TW) possesses full capacity for both MLCCs and chip resistors, and its products are already embedded in multiple end‑applications, giving it a more complete footing to capture mature‑part order switches than a single‑product supplier.

China’s MLCC market is seeing a new division of labor. AI demand has caused Japanese and Korean firms to cut some consumer‑grade capacity, prompting international laptop brands and OEMs to accelerate qualification of Chinese memory and passive‑component suppliers. Chinese factories are therefore expanding their order book in mid‑ and low‑end parts, while high‑end server components still rely on Japanese/Korean technology and yields. Hwa Shin operates a plant in Dalang, Dongguan, allowing close proximity to Chinese customers while leveraging Taiwan and Malaysia capacity for the global supply chain—a cross‑regional setup that positions it well to capture re‑allocated orders.

The supply re‑allocation is also tightening pricing. Industry data show that major Japanese and Korean players have begun adjusting Q4 prices, and quotations for some MLCCs from Taiwanese and Chinese suppliers are moving upward. Raw‑material, labor and expansion costs are rising in tandem, and Hwa Shin has signaled a price‑increase direction. Going forward, it will be important to see whether channel‑level price hikes filter through to end customers and whether the improved mix of high‑end parts continues to lift revenue.

This year Hwa Shin’s capital expenditure has risen to NT$3‑4 billion, with plans to increase capacity by roughly 10% each in the next two years. Chip‑resistor expansion is focused on Malaysia and Dalang, while MLCC capacity growth centers on Kaohsiung and Dalang, both of which are already operating at high utilization. By preparing factory space in advance and then installing equipment and obtaining certifications, the company can shorten the time needed to bring new capacity online, supporting both AI‑spec parts and mature‑part order switches.

August’s revenue continued to set a new segment high. Coupled with Murata’s shift away from mature parts and Japanese/Korean firms’ pivot toward AI products, Hwa Shin’s growth sources are clearer than at the start of the month. The research now centers on whether monthly revenue can stay at the high end, the order‑to‑shipment ratio and visibility, the pace of price adjustments with direct customers, order switches in the Chinese market, and the production ramp‑up of new capacity in Kaohsiung, Dalang and Malaysia. As long as these indicators are realized, operational upside remains.

items.title: 金融力挺低碳轉型！新光合纖56.25億永續聯貸案到位 9家銀行超額認購1.43倍
items.title_en: Financial Sector Backs Low‑Carbon Transition! Shin Kong Synthetic Fiber’s NT$5.625 B Sustainable Syndicated Loan Secured, 9 Banks Over‑Subscribed 1.43‑Times
paras: 兆豐銀行、國泰世華銀行及台北富邦銀行共同統籌主辦新光合成纖維 (1409-TW) 56.25億元永續聯貸案，於今（22）日完成簽約。本案吸引9家金融機構踴躍參與，市場反應熱烈，最終獲1.43倍超額認購。資金將用於償還金融借款、優化財務結構並充實中期營運週轉金，同時支應循環經濟布局與綠色製程升級。本案納入永續連結授信機制，若企業達成溫室氣體減量等目標可享有利率優惠，展現金融業引導產業低碳轉型的正向影響力。
隨著全球淨零排放趨勢加速推進，循環經濟已成為企業提升永續競爭力的重要策略，金融機構亦持續透過創新融資機制，引導產業落實低碳轉型。為支持國內企業深化永續經營及循環經濟發展，兆豐銀行、國泰世華銀行及台北富邦銀行共同統籌主辦新光合成纖維56.25億元聯貸案，於今日完成簽約。
本案由兆豐銀行擔任額度管理銀行、國泰世華擔任文件管理銀行、台北富邦擔任ESG管理銀行，共獲9家金融機構踴躍參與，募集期間市場反應熱烈，超額認購達1.43倍，顯示金融同業高度肯定新光合纖的經營績效、產業領導地位，以及持續推動永續發展的發展策略。
新光合纖為國內聚酯產業重要領導企業，產品橫跨化學纖維、工程塑膠、包裝材料及光學膜等領域，廣泛應用於紡織、電子及光電等產業。憑藉完整產業鏈布局、優異研發能力及多元產品優勢，長期深耕海內外市場，持續提升高附加價值產品比重，展現穩健的成長動能與國際競爭力。
近年來，新光合纖積極投入循環經濟與低碳轉型發展，持續擴大再生聚酯產品布局，並積極投入食品級再生材料及回收再利用技術研發，不僅取得多項國際認證，更透過節能減碳、再生能源導入及水資源管理等具體措施，逐步落實淨零排放與永續發展目標，展現企業善盡環境責任的決心與成果。

本次聯貸資金主要用於償還金融借款並充實中期營運週轉金，以優化財務結構及提升資金運用效率，並支應新光合纖持續推進循環經濟布局、綠色製程升級轉型及高附加價值產品發展所需資金。值得一提的是，本案納入永續連結授信機制，將貸款利率與特定永續績效指標連結，涵蓋溫室氣體減量、水資源管理及公司治理等指標。當企業達成預設永續目標時，即可享有相應利率優惠，透過具體金融誘因鼓勵企業深化ESG行動，充分展現金融業引導企業邁向永續發展的正向影響力。

兆豐銀行、台北富邦銀行及國泰世華銀行長期深耕聯貸市場及永續金融領域。其中，兆豐銀行自2020年以來已4度榮獲亞太區貸款市場公會評選為台灣年度最佳聯貸銀行；國泰世華銀行以跨境聯貸及永續融資專業屢獲國際機構肯定；台北富邦銀行憑藉卓越永續金融表現，連續4年榮獲台灣最佳ESG銀行。3家統籌主辦銀行未來將持續發揮金融核心職能，攜手優質企業推動低碳轉型與永續發展，共同提升產業競爭力，創造企業、社會與環境共榮共好的永續價值。
paras_en: Mega International Commercial Bank, Cathay United Bank and Taipei Fubon Bank jointly coordinated and hosted Shin Kong Synthetic Fiber (1409‑TW)’s NT$5.625 billion sustainable syndicated loan, completing the signing today (the 22nd). The deal attracted enthusiastic participation from nine financial institutions, receiving a 1.43‑times oversubscription. The funds will be used to repay existing loans, optimise the capital structure and bolster mid‑term working capital, while also supporting circular‑economy initiatives and green‑process upgrades. The loan incorporates a sustainability‑linked credit mechanism that offers interest‑rate discounts if the company meets greenhouse‑gas‑reduction targets, showcasing the finance industry’s positive influence in guiding low‑carbon transformation.

Amid accelerating global net‑zero trends, circular‑economy strategies have become key for firms to enhance sustainable competitiveness, and financial institutions continue to innovate financing tools to steer industries toward low‑carbon transitions. To support domestic companies in deepening sustainable operations and circular‑economy development, Mega International, Cathay United and Taipei Fubon jointly coordinated Shin Kong Synthetic Fiber’s NT$5.625 billion syndicated loan, finalising the agreement today.

Mega International acted as the facility‑administration bank, Cathay United as the documentation bank, and Taipei Fubon as the ESG‑management bank. Nine financial institutions participated enthusiastically, and the market response during the fundraising period was strong, achieving a 1.43‑times oversubscription. This reflects the banking sector’s high confidence in Shin Kong Synthetic Fiber’s performance, industry leadership, and its ongoing sustainability strategy.

Shin Kong Synthetic Fiber is a leading domestic polyester producer, with products spanning chemical fibers, engineering plastics, packaging materials and optical films, widely used in textiles, electronics and optoelectronics. Leveraging a complete industry‑chain footprint, strong R&D capabilities and diversified product lines, the company has long cultivated both domestic and overseas markets, continuously raising the share of high‑value‑added products and demonstrating solid growth momentum and international competitiveness.

In recent years, Shin Kong Synthetic Fiber has actively pursued circular‑economy and low‑carbon development, expanding its recycled polyester portfolio and investing in food‑grade recycled materials and recycling technologies. The firm has earned multiple international certifications and, through energy‑saving, carbon‑reduction, renewable‑energy adoption and water‑resource management measures, is progressively achieving net‑zero and sustainable‑development goals, underscoring its commitment and results in environmental stewardship.

The syndicated‑loan proceeds will primarily repay existing financial borrowings and reinforce mid‑term working capital, thereby optimising the capital structure and improving fund‑use efficiency. They will also finance Shin Kong Synthetic Fiber’s ongoing circular‑economy projects, green‑process upgrades and high‑value‑added product development. Notably, the loan features a sustainability‑linked credit mechanism that ties the interest rate to specific ESG performance metrics—including greenhouse‑gas reduction, water‑resource management and corporate‑governance targets—granting rate discounts when the preset sustainability goals are met, thus using concrete financial incentives to encourage deeper ESG action and highlighting the finance sector’s role in steering companies toward sustainable development.

Mega International, Taipei Fubon and Cathay United have long specialised in syndicated‑loan markets and sustainable finance. Mega International has been named Taiwan’s Best Syndicated Loan Bank by the Asia‑Pacific Loan Market Association four times since 2020; Cathay United is repeatedly recognised internationally for cross‑border syndications and sustainable‑finance expertise; and Taipei Fubon has won Taiwan’s Best ESG Bank award for four consecutive years. The three coordinating banks will continue to leverage their core financial functions, partnering with quality enterprises to drive low‑carbon transformation and sustainable growth, thereby enhancing industry competitiveness and creating shared value for businesses, society and the environment.

items.title: 警訊浮現！標普500強勢攻高 為什麼近6成成分股悄悄進入熊市？
items.title_en: Alert Signals Appear! S&P 500 Races Higher—Why Nearly 60% of Its Components Have Quietly Slipped Into a Bear Market?
paras: 在科技股及其他人工智慧(AI)概念股帶動下，標普500指數正直逼先前創下的歷史新高，但亮麗的表現背後出現令人擔憂的趨勢：近六成成分股與歷史高點相比跌逾20%——換句話說，參與股市漲勢的股票比例正在縮小。
根據道瓊市場數據，標普500指數周一(21日)收盤距離8月13日創下的歷史收盤高點7798.99點僅差0.4%。與此同時，那斯達克綜合指數同日收盤突破6月初創下的前一波高點27093.90點。

大型科技股領漲 AMD股價飆近10%

經歷一段表現溫吞的行情後，Meta(META-US)在內的「科技七巨頭」(Magnificent Seven)中的大型科技股周一重新扮演重要推手。半導體股、記憶體股及硬體股也大幅走高，超微(AMD-US)股價飆升9.95%。
這波漲勢凸顯企業獲利驚人增長的吸引力，以及未來幾年AI建設可望每年帶來約1兆美元資本支出的龐大投資熱潮。
然而股市表面之下仍存在弱勢，關稅、通膨、能源價格飆升及借貸成本上升，都已對市場造成壓力。
Ameriprise首席市場策略師Anthony Saglimbene說：「市場廣度實際上已經惡化，儘管指數正逐步逼近歷史新高。」他指的是目前參與股市漲勢的股票比例正在縮小。
Saglimbene表示，儘管AI概念股重新受到市場青睞，但公用事業股表現疲弱，非必需消費品類股也面臨壓力，包括汽車零組件、紡織品及精品相關股票，「很多股票都遠低於52周高點。」

標普逼近新高 逾半成分股卻跌逾20%

儘管標普500指數重新逼近8月高點，但根據道瓊市場數據，標普500成分股中有59.2%較歷史高點下跌至少20%。
華爾街許多人將從歷史高點下跌至少20%視為進入熊市的定義。不過，許多重挫的標普500成分股近期波動劇烈，幾個月內就可能出現20%甚至更大的漲跌幅。
根據道瓊市場數據，至少自2017年底以來，標普500指數從未在距離歷史高點不到1%的同時，還有如此高比例的成分股較自己曾創下的歷史高點下跌20%以上。這也是2022年10月這波多頭行情啟動以來，首度出現這種情況。
不過，雖然有些投資人認為這反映市場潛在風險，但也有一派認為這顯示市場仍具韌性。
富蘭克林坦伯頓研究所(Franklin Templeton Institute)資深市場策略師Chris Galipeau表示，一般人可能會認為「事情會開始失控」，例如汽油與柴油價格飆升、伊朗戰爭，以及聯準會(Fed)實現2%通膨目標的公信力遭質疑等問題。
但Galipeau表示，今年前六個月美國經濟與企業獲利的韌性都超出預期，「這個故事很被難反駁」，除非Fed最終大幅升息並拖累經濟成長。

油價與高殖利率仍是市場隱憂

儘管如此，伊朗戰爭、10年期美國公債殖利率接近5%，以及Fed重新強化抗通膨立場，都影響目前投資人的資金配置方向。
美國汽油價格目前每加侖衝上4.50美元，柴油價格也達到創紀錄的每加侖6.50美元，同時生活成本及借貸成本也持續上升。
然而，即使Fed升息一次或數次，預料也不太會阻止超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)繼續為AI大舉投資。
Schwab金融研究中心宏觀經濟研究與策略主管Kevin Gordon說：「這一直是一個大規模的資金輪動過程。但對我而言，這就是今年市場的本質。你會看到某些產業與類股出現一段時間的疲弱，但不會所有產業同時走弱。」
全球基準布蘭特原油價格這三個月來上漲約25%，重新回到每桶100美元，加劇了許多家庭的生活成本危機。
然而，標普500中的許多能源股仍在接近歷史高點的位置交易，包括馬拉松石油(MPC-US)、Valero Energy(VLO-US)及Phillips 66(PSX-US)。這些個股周一都收黑，跌幅在4-5%之間。
Gordon形容，市場目前呈現「謹慎攀越憂慮之牆」的格局。
paras_en: Driven by tech stocks and other artificial‑intelligence (AI) concept shares, the S&P 500 index is closing in on its previous all‑time high, but a worrying trend lurks behind the shine: almost six‑tenths of its components have fallen more than 20% from their historic peaks—meaning the share of stocks participating in the market rally is shrinking.

According to Dow Jones market data, the S&P 500 closed on Monday (the 21st) just 0.4% shy of the August 13 record closing high of 7,798.99 points. At the same time, the Nasdaq Composite also broke through its early‑June peak of 27,093.90 points on the same day.

Large‑cap tech leads the surge – AMD jumps nearly 10% After a period of tepid performance, the “Magnificent Seven” tech giants, including Meta (META‑US), returned to the forefront on Monday. Semiconductor, memory and hardware stocks also rallied sharply, with AMD (AMD‑US) soaring 9.95%.

The rally underscores the appeal of astonishing corporate profit growth and the massive investment wave expected as AI build‑out could drive roughly $1 trillion of capital spending each year over the next few years.
Nevertheless, weakness remains beneath the market’s surface: tariffs, inflation, soaring energy prices and rising borrowing costs have all put pressure on equities.

Ameriprise chief market strategist Anthony Saglimbene said, “Market breadth has actually deteriorated even as the index inches toward a new high.” He is referring to the shrinking proportion of stocks that are joining the rally.

Saglimbene noted that while AI‑related stocks have regained favor, utility shares are lagging and non‑essential consumer stocks – including auto parts, textiles and luxury‑related equities – are under pressure, with “many stocks far below their 52‑week highs.”

S&P nears new high but over half its components are down more than 20% Even as the S&P 500 closes in on the August peak, Dow Jones data show that 59.2% of its constituents are at least 20% below their historic highs.

Many on Wall Street treat a drop of 20% or more from a historic high as the definition of a bear market. Yet many heavily‑hit S&P 500 stocks have been extremely volatile lately and could swing 20% or more within a few months.

Dow Jones data indicate that, at least since the end of 2017, the S&P 500 has never been within 1% of its all‑time high while simultaneously having such a high share of components down more than 20% from their own peaks. This is the first time this has happened since the bullish run that began in October 2022.
Some investors see this as a sign of underlying risk, while others argue it shows the market’s resilience.

Franklin Templeton Institute senior market strategist Chris Galipeau said most people might think “things are getting out of control,” citing soaring gasoline and diesel prices, the Iran war, and doubts about the Fed’s credibility in hitting a 2% inflation target.

Galipeau added that U.S. economic and corporate earnings resilience in the first six months of the year has exceeded expectations, “this story is hard to refute” unless the Fed ultimately raises rates sharply enough to drag down growth.

Oil prices and high yields remain market worries Nonetheless, the Iran conflict, the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield hovering near 5%, and the Fed’s renewed anti‑inflation stance are shaping investors’ asset‑allocation decisions.
U.S. gasoline is now around $4.50 per gallon and diesel has hit a record $6.50 per gallon, while living‑cost and borrowing pressures continue to rise.
Even if the Fed hikes rates once or a few times, it is unlikely to halt hyperscalers from continuing massive AI investments.

Kevin Gordon, head of macro‑economic research and strategy at Schwab’s research center, said, “It’s been a massive capital‑rotation process. To me, that’s the essence of this year’s market. You’ll see some sectors and groups weaken for a spell, but not all sectors will falter together.”
Global benchmark Brent crude has risen about 25% over the past three months, returning to $100 a barrel and intensifying cost‑of‑living crises for many households.

Nevertheless, many energy stocks in the S&P 500 are still trading near historic highs, including Marathon Petroleum (MPC‑US), Valero Energy (VLO‑US) and Phillips 66 (PSX‑US). All three closed in the red on Monday, slipping 4‑5%.
Gordon described the market’s current state as a “cautious climb over a wall of concern.”

items.title: 馬斯克聯手輝達押注軌道AI！100萬顆衛星上限已申請  太空機房要比星鏈大百倍
items.title_en: Musk Teams with Nvidia to Bet on Orbital AI! 1 Million Satellite Cap Already Applied, Space Data Centers to Be Hundreds of Times Larger Than Starlink
paras: 矽谷知名投資人、巴倫資本創辦人Ron Baron上周四(17日)在面向客戶的投資人大會上，系統地推廣馬斯克旗下軌道AI專案「Starmind(星智)」。
Baron把太空資料中心的成本邏輯概括為：地面資料中心是「10美元資本投入加每年2美元維護運作」，太空則是「一次性2美元」；衛星每5年換一代、效能提升10倍，10年內容量可翻100倍，未來每年能湊出100GW電力。不過，這些數據均來自Baron個人表述，而非第三方審計結論。
監理端與工程端的進展則是有據可查。美國聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)今年2月4日發佈公開通知，接受SpaceX的軌道資料中心系統申請並徵求公眾意見。
文件顯示，SpaceX今年1月30日申請在500至2000公里高度的近地軌道部署最多100萬顆衛星，運行於30度及太陽同步軌道傾角，主要依靠星間光鏈路互聯，並可連接第一代、第二代星鏈衛星。同時，SpaceX在申請中請求豁免NGSO部署進度節點、保證金等義務，並要求免於按處理輪次申請18.3—19.3GHz及28.6—29.1GHz頻段。
需要區分的是，100萬顆是向FCC申請的系統規模上限，不等於實際部署量。星鏈當年申請4.2萬顆、實際在軌約1萬顆，申請規模預留未來餘裕為航太業慣例。
賓州大學教授Benjamin C. Lee先前公開表示，目前全球在軌衛星合計約1.5萬顆。此外，申請文件未揭露衛星尺寸、重量、具體軌道參數、部署時間表與成本預估，技術細節缺失仍是監管與產業界的核心質疑。
與輝達的合作關係已由官方確認。輝達上月24日宣布，SpaceXAI計畫將加速運算能力延伸至太空，第一代Starmind AI衛星將基於優化後的輝達Vera Rubin NVL72機架級系統構建，雙方正共同適配軌道運算在供電、熱管理、頻寬、可靠性與物理整合上的約束。
SpaceX在財報電話會議上指出，未來所有AI算力將獨家採用輝達架構，首顆AI衛星計畫於今年第四季發射，2028年達到顯著規模
成本與資本開支是爭議最集中的環節。伍德麥肯錫(Wood Mackenzie)在報告中估算，一個假設性的1GW軌道資料中心造價約1700億美元，是地面同等設施的3倍以上，其中發射與衛星成本約佔總成本的60%，但要將軌道成本降至與地面持平，需實現70%的成本降幅。
伍德麥肯錫基準情境甚至未納入大規模軌道資料中心，明確指出其目前仍是「對成本曲線的押注」。
資本開支方面，摩根士丹利分析師Adam Jonas預估，SpaceX 2026年AI相關資本支出約530億美元，2027年約1300億美元，折合每瓦約40美元。支援方認為，軌道資料中心可規避地面設施的監管障礙與社區阻力，星艦推動的發射成本下降將持續改善經濟性。
但批評人士指出，昂貴的AI晶片與高昂的發射成本仍是現實門檻，現階段經濟模型尚未跑通。
另有投行給予較樂觀的長線判斷，認為SpaceX到2031年底可部署約75GW軌道算力，成本顯著低於地面建設，可望成為其發射與星鏈業務以外的新營收來源。
paras_en: Silicon Valley investor and Baren Capital founder Ron Baron promoted Elon Musk’s orbital AI project “Starmind” to clients at a conference on Thursday, the 17th.

Baron summarized the cost logic of space data centers as: a ground data center costs $10 in capital plus $2 per year in operating expenses, while space costs a one‑time $2; satellites are refreshed every five years with ten‑fold performance gains, yielding a hundred‑fold increase in capacity over ten years and the ability to generate 100 GW of power annually. These figures come from Baron’s own statements, not third‑party audits.

Regulatory and engineering progress can be verified. The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) issued a public notice on February 4, accepting SpaceX’s orbital data‑center system application and seeking public comment.

The filing shows SpaceX applied on Jan 30 to deploy up to 1 million satellites in low‑Earth orbit at 500‑2,000 km, operating at 30° and sun‑synchronous inclinations, primarily linked via inter‑satellite optical links and compatible with first‑ and second‑generation Starlink satellites. SpaceX also requested waivers for NGSO deployment milestones, security deposits and exemption from filing for the 18.3‑19.3 GHz and 28.6‑29.1 GHz bands on a per‑round basis.

It should be noted that the 1 million figure is the maximum system size requested from the FCC, not the actual deployment count. Starlink originally applied for 42,000 satellites but has about 10,000 in orbit, a common practice of reserving future capacity in the aerospace industry.

University of Pennsylvania professor Benjamin C. Lee has previously stated that roughly 15,000 satellites are currently in orbit worldwide. The application does not disclose satellite size, mass, exact orbital parameters, deployment schedule or cost estimates, leaving technical details a core concern for regulators and the industry.

The partnership with Nvidia has been confirmed by officials. Nvidia announced on the 24th of last month that the SpaceX AI project will extend compute power to space, with the first‑generation Starmind AI satellites built on an optimized Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 rack‑level system, and both parties are jointly adapting orbital computing to constraints in power, thermal management, bandwidth, reliability and physical integration.

SpaceX said in its earnings call that all future AI compute will exclusively use Nvidia architecture, with the first AI satellite slated for launch in Q4 this year and a significant scale expected by 2028.

Cost and capital expenditure are the most contentious issues. Wood Mackenzie estimated in a report that a hypothetical 1 GW orbital data center would cost about $170 billion, more than three times the cost of an equivalent ground facility, with launch and satellite costs accounting for roughly 60 % of total cost; a 70 % cost reduction would be needed to bring orbital costs in line with ground‑based ones.
Wood Mackenzie’s baseline scenario does not even include a large‑scale orbital data center, explicitly stating that it remains a bet on the cost curve.

On the cap‑ex side, Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Jonas projects SpaceX’s AI‑related capital spending at about $53 billion in 2026 and $130 billion in 2027, roughly $40 per watt. Proponents argue that orbital data centers avoid ground‑based regulatory hurdles and community opposition, and that the cost reductions from Starship launches will continue to improve economics.
Critics counter that expensive AI chips and high launch costs remain real barriers, and that the economic model is not yet proven.

Some investment banks are more optimistic long‑term, estimating SpaceX could have roughly 75 GW of orbital compute capacity deployed by the end of 2031, at costs significantly lower than ground construction, potentially becoming a new revenue stream beyond its launch and Starlink businesses.

items.title: 比爾蓋茲警告：AI就像人造外星人 不能再當普通科技看待
items.title_en: Bill Gates Warns: AI Is Like Man‑Made Aliens, No Longer a Ordinary Technology
paras: 比爾蓋茲近日表示，人工智慧（AI）與過往所有技術都不一樣，若僅將其視為既有科技的延續，恐怕容易掉以輕心。他更將AI發展比喻為「外星人降臨」，強調這些「外星人」不是搭乘太空船而來，而是由人類親手創造，並被置入電腦之中。
蓋茲在紐約出席基金會目標守衛者會議時指出，他原本希望自己只需要談論對外援助，以及如何降低兒童死亡率，但AI快速發展，使他在與各國領導人會面時，不得不同時討論另一項迫切問題：社會是否已為這場變革做好準備，以及如何面對技術可能帶來的風險。
AI進展之快，約在一年前便讓蓋茲感到震驚。他指出，AI如今已能完成程式設計工作，而這項技能是他年輕時花費大量時間才得以掌握。
AI不僅可以編寫程式碼，也能研究程式碼、找出漏洞，甚至可能被用來入侵各類系統，展現出的能力已超越單純提升效率的工具。
不過，真正令蓋茲擔憂的並非只有技術本身，而是社會尚未對AI的指數級進步展開足夠廣泛的參與和討論。
科技業內部雖已開始探討相關風險，但更廣泛的大眾仍未充分投入，社會對這項技術的理解與準備，明顯落後於AI演進速度。
蓋茲形容，當前的改變就像「十本科幻小說裡的情節同時發生」。傳統科幻作品通常只圍繞一項重大技術突破展開，但AI可能同時推動多個領域快速變革，因此不能再以過往看待單一科技創新的方式加以理解。
他強調，AI極為特殊，人類未來將走向何方，取決於如何對待這項技術。因應AI挑戰的第一步，是讓更多人參與其中，不僅成為技術的使用者，也要了解背後潛藏的風險，避免AI議題只停留在科技產業內部。
蓋茲也提醒，AI具有明顯的兩面性。一方面，它可望在農業與公共衛生領域推動創新；另一方面，也可能帶來難以忽視的安全風險。如何合理運用AI、同時建立對風險的認識，將成為社會必須共同面對的課題。
談及全球發展時，蓋茲對部分富裕國家削減對低收入國家的援助表示遺憾。他指出，在經濟持續成長、企業獲利屢創新高之際，許多富裕國家的政府卻變得更加吝嗇。
他並非要求世界的一部分拯救另一部分，而是主張透過慷慨投入推動共同進步，協助資源匱乏、仍努力挽救生命的社區。
蓋茲呼籲恢復資金支持，以保障最基本的生存需求。他認為，若能將更多公益投入與AI的合理運用相結合，便有機會加快實現全球公平的目標。
paras_en: Bill Gates recently said that artificial intelligence (AI) is unlike any technology before; treating it merely as a continuation of existing tech could lead to complacency. He likened AI development to “aliens arriving,” emphasizing that these “aliens” aren’t coming in spaceships but are created by humans and embedded in computers.

Speaking at the Foundation’s Guardians of the Goal conference in New York, Gates noted that he originally hoped to talk only about foreign aid and how to reduce child mortality, but the rapid advance of AI forced him, when meeting world leaders, to also discuss a pressing issue: whether society is ready for this transformation and how to confront the risks the technology may bring.
The speed of AI progress shocked Gates about a year ago. He pointed out that AI can now perform programming tasks—a skill he spent a great deal of time mastering when he was younger.
AI can not only write code but also analyze it, find vulnerabilities, and could even be used to breach various systems, showing capabilities that go beyond being a simple efficiency‑boosting tool.
However, what truly worries Gates is not just the technology itself but the fact that society has not engaged broadly enough in discussion about AI’s exponential advancement.

While the tech industry has begun to explore related risks, the wider public remains insufficiently involved; society’s understanding and preparation for this technology lag clearly behind the pace of AI’s evolution.

Gates described the current change as “ten sci‑fi novel plots happening at once.” Traditional sci‑fi usually focuses on a single breakthrough, but AI may drive rapid transformation across multiple fields simultaneously, so it can no longer be understood through the lens of past single‑technology innovations.

He stressed that AI is exceptionally unique, and humanity’s future direction depends on how we treat it. The first step in meeting AI’s challenges is to involve more people—not just as users of the technology but also as aware of its hidden risks—to prevent AI discussions from staying confined to the tech industry.

Gates also warned that AI has a clear dual nature. On one hand, it promises innovation in agriculture and public health; on the other, it poses significant security risks. Balancing sensible AI use with risk awareness will become a societal issue that must be tackled together.

When speaking about global development, Gates expressed regret over some wealthy nations cutting aid to low‑income countries. He noted that while economies keep growing and corporate profits hit record highs, many rich‑country governments are becoming more stingy.
He is not calling for one part of the world to rescue another, but advocates generous investment to drive shared progress, helping resource‑poor communities that are still striving to save lives.

Gates urged the restoration of funding to secure basic survival needs. He believes that if more philanthropy is combined with responsible AI deployment, there is an opportunity to accelerate the achievement of global equity.

items.title: 防AI自主升級失控！OpenAI提安全新標準 聚焦對齊研究與RSI技術風險
items.title_en: OpenAI Sets New Safety Standards to Prevent Uncontrolled AI Self‑Upgrade, Focuses on Alignment Research and RSI Risks
paras: OpenAI周一(21日)公布一套針對尖端人工智慧(AI)開發安全與防護的建議，重點放在「對齊研究」(alignment research)，以及一項稱為「遞迴自我改進」(recursive self-improvement, RSI)的運算技術。
OpenAI在部落格文章中表示：「要安全的因應這項轉變，需要讓對齊研究跟上這些能力的發展速度，確保我們及其他業者開發的系統，持續與人類價值觀一致，並受到人類控制。」

OpenAI籲國際合作制定標準

OpenAI呼籲各國展開國際合作，共同制定先進AI標準，並建議在全球現有AI安全研究機構的工作基礎上進一步發展。
OpenAI表示，這些技術標準應聚焦於前沿AI模型與開發商，以及對自動化AI研究人員進行利益與風險管理，包括RSI。
RSI受到AI開發商關注，因其具有打造基礎模型的潛力，讓AI系統能夠在沒有人工介入的情況下自行升級。
但RSI領域的進展也引發部分科技人士的疑慮，擔心模型開發商可能失去對根本技術的控制，或無法充分考量AI系統日益複雜、並廣泛存在於網際網路後，可能產生的非預期後果。
OpenAI在部落格文章中表示：「完全自主的RSI目前尚未實現，我們不應追求這項技術，除非且直到它能夠以安全的方式實現。如果沒有適當的重視與謹慎，RSI可能導致人類失去對AI開發的實際控制，甚至無法對自己已無法理解的研究流程進行監督。」

Hugging Face事件成風險預演

OpenAI的文章也提到Hugging Face遭AI代理程式駭入的事件。該事件並未涉及RSI技術，但OpenAI認為，這可視為未來若缺乏強健防護措施與對齊機制時，相關風險可能大幅加劇的預演。
競爭對手Anthropic上周也提出前沿AI模型安全開發的相關構想，回應近期業界研究人員接連對AI可能威脅人類的警告。
曾任職於Anthropic與OpenAI的Jacob Coxon在約兩周前宣布辭職，他當時表示，這些公司正在「拿我們的生命下注」，當時引發全球熱烈討論。在近期一連串與AI相關的資安事件，以及Coxon公開發表看法後，Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)發表文章，呼籲AI公司放慢基礎模型開發速度，並提出其他安全措施。
阿莫戴也提出讓第三方評估機構進駐AI公司的構想，以審查並降低相關技術可能對社會造成的風險，例如加速資安駭客攻擊，或協助製造生物武器。
OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)，以及SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克等競爭對手陣營的領導人，也公開支持阿莫戴的提議。

AI安全評估標準仍未形成共識

不過，由於AI評估領域仍處於非常早期的階段，目前尚未形成統一共識，也沒有無一套基本標準與原則，能讓獨立第三方比目前更深入地檢視。
這也是AI評估機構聯盟呼籲基礎模型開發商考慮一套「最低條件」的部分原因，目的是讓評估機構能更深入執行技術稽核與檢查，包括取得更深層的系統存取權，以及避免因發布不利報告而遭報復。
paras_en: OpenAI announced on Monday (21st) a set of recommendations for the safety and protection of cutting‑edge artificial intelligence (AI) development, emphasizing "alignment research" and a computational technique called "recursive self‑improvement" (RSI).

In its blog post, OpenAI stated: "To safely respond to this shift, alignment research must keep pace with the development of these capabilities, ensuring that systems we and other industry players develop remain aligned with human values and under human control."
OpenAI calls for international cooperation to establish advanced AI standards, suggesting further development built on the work of existing global AI safety research institutions.
OpenAI said these technical standards should focus on frontier AI models and developers, and on managing the benefits and risks for automated AI researchers, including RSI.
RSI has attracted attention from AI developers because of its potential to build foundational models that allow AI systems to upgrade themselves without human intervention.

However, progress in the RSI field has also raised concerns among some technologists, who worry that model developers may lose control over the underlying technology or fail to fully consider the unintended consequences that could arise as AI systems become increasingly complex and widely present on the internet.

In its blog post, OpenAI wrote: "Fully autonomous RSI has not yet been realized; we should not pursue this technology unless and until it can be implemented safely. Without proper attention and caution, RSI could cause humans to lose practical control over AI development, or even be unable to supervise research processes that we cannot understand."

The OpenAI article also mentioned the Hugging Face incident involving an AI agent hack. Although the incident did not involve RSI technology, OpenAI views it as a rehearsal of how risks could be greatly amplified in the future if robust protective measures and alignment mechanisms are lacking.
Last week, competitor Anthropic also proposed ideas for the safe development of frontier AI models, responding to recent warnings from industry researchers about AI potentially threatening humanity.

Jacob Coxon, who had worked at both Anthropic and OpenAI, announced his resignation about two weeks ago, stating that these companies were "betting our lives" on the technology, sparking global debate. Following a series of recent AI‑related cybersecurity incidents and Coxon's public statements, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published an article urging AI companies to slow the pace of foundational model development and propose additional safety measures.

Amodei also suggested bringing third‑party evaluation bodies into AI companies to review and reduce the potential societal risks of the technology, such as accelerating cyber‑hacking or aiding the creation of biological weapons.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, and other leaders from competing camps publicly supported Amodei's proposal.

However, because the AI evaluation field is still in its very early stages, there is no unified consensus or a set of basic standards and principles that would allow independent third parties to examine more deeply than currently possible.

This is also one of the reasons the AI Evaluation Alliance calls on foundational model developers to consider a "minimum set of conditions," aiming to enable evaluation bodies to conduct more thorough technical audits and inspections, including gaining deeper system access and avoiding retaliation for publishing unfavorable reports.

items.title: 1450億美元AI豪賭開始兌現？Muse成Meta消費市場突破口
items.title_en: $145 Billion AI Bet Starts Paying Off? Muse Becomes Meta's Consumer Market Breakthrough
paras: Meta平台(META-US) 本月推出的個人AI代理Muse迅速竄紅，下載量超越OpenAI的ChatGPT。這波熱度不僅帶動Meta股價單日大漲逾11%，也讓市場首度看見，Meta今年最高1,450億美元的AI資本支出，可能透過消費級產品轉化為實際回報。
Muse於本月8日在美國上線，定位並非單純回答問題的聊天機器人，而是能代替使用者執行多步驟任務的個人AI代理。
它可查詢不同帳戶中的資訊、填寫網頁表單、預訂行程、安排約會、發送郵件與訊息，甚至協助完成部分線上購物。使用者除了可透過獨立應用程式操作，也能從WhatsApp進入。
富國銀行分析師高雷爾斯基（Ken Gawrelski）認為，Muse等產品反映消費AI正從聊天機器人走向個人助理，AI不再只生成文字，而是開始代表使用者採取行動。
Muse的下載表現迅速反映在股價上。Meta周一(21日)大漲11.43%，收在741.24美元，9月累計漲幅接近30%，逼近今年1月以來最高收盤水準。
此前，投資人持續擔憂Meta的AI支出過於龐大，Muse則讓市場第一次看到，消費端產品有機會直接承接這些投資。
Meta今年預計資本支出達1,300億至1,450億美元，主要投入資料中心與AI基礎設施。儘管傳統廣告業務依然強勁，但大規模新增算力能否形成獨立收入來源，一直缺乏直觀證明。
如今Muse不只在下載榜超越ChatGPT，也建立更明確的收費模式，基礎版本免費，進階方案月費分別為20美元與100美元，有望將AI使用量轉化為經常性收入。
Meta也同步建立其他AI變現管道。公司上周推出Meta One，在分階段上線期間已累積1,500萬份訂閱與試用；另推出Model API，首度向開發者與企業收費開放底層模型能力。
Muse面向消費者，Meta One涵蓋既有社群產品，Model API則連結企業與開發者，三條路徑讓AI收入來源從廣告延伸至不同付費場景。
Meta龐大的使用者規模，更是Muse擴張的關鍵優勢。截至6月30日，包括Instagram、Facebook與WhatsApp在內的應用程式家族，日活躍用戶達36億人。
Muse若能嵌入這些平台，就不必從零建立分發管道，這是其他須獨立爭取下載量與使用時間的AI產品難以比擬的條件。
不過，Muse要真正成為交易型代理，仍須跨過第三方平台這一關。個人代理若要完成購物、旅遊與郵件等任務，必須存取使用者經常使用的網站，其能力愈強，也愈依賴外部平台是否願意開放。
亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 已要求Meta將其購物平台從Muse體驗中移除，並指Meta事前未告知Muse將存取Amazon商店，也未獲授權。Amazon同時對帳戶資料抓取與敏感資訊處理提出疑問，主張第三方AI應保持透明，並尊重平台是否參與的決定。
Meta則表示，Muse無法看到使用者密碼或付款資訊，憑證會被安全保存，代理可在不查看內容的情況下使用。
雙方立場差異顯示，當AI從回答問題跨入實際交易，平台授權與資料存取邊界也將成為新戰場。
Meta年度Connect大會將於當地時間周三登場，市場預期公司可能公布更多Muse使用數據與新功能。
當最高1,450億美元的資本支出已成投資人焦點，活躍用戶、訂閱轉換率與任務完成能力，將是檢驗Meta這場AI豪賭能否真正兌現的關鍵指標。
paras_en: Meta's platform (META-US) launched its personal AI agent Muse this month, quickly going viral and surpassing OpenAI's ChatGPT in downloads. The hype not only drove Meta's stock up more than 11% in a single day, but also gave the market its first glimpse that Meta's up to $145 billion AI capital spend this year could be turned into real returns through consumer products.
Muse went live in the United States on the 8th of this month, positioned not as a simple question‑answer chatbot but as a personal AI agent that can perform multi‑step tasks on behalf of users.

It can pull information from different accounts, fill out web forms, book trips, schedule appointments, send emails and messages, and even help complete parts of online shopping. Users can operate it via a standalone app or access it through WhatsApp.
Wells Fargo analyst Ken Gawrelski said products like Muse show consumer AI moving from chatbots to personal assistants, with AI no longer just generating text but actually taking actions for users.

Muse's download surge quickly reflected in the stock price. Meta jumped 11.43% on Monday (the 21st), closing at $741.24, up nearly 30% for September and approaching its highest closing level since January this year.
Previously, investors had been worried that Meta's AI spending was too large; Muse gave the market its first view that consumer‑facing products could directly capture those investments.

Meta expects capital expenditures of $130 billion to $145 billion this year, mainly for data centers and AI infrastructure. While traditional ad revenue remains strong, there has been no clear proof that the massive new compute capacity can generate an independent revenue stream.

Now Muse not only tops the download charts over ChatGPT but also has a clearer monetisation model: a free basic version and premium plans priced at $20 and $100 per month, potentially turning AI usage into recurring revenue.

Meta is also building other AI monetisation channels. Last week the company rolled out Meta One, which has already amassed 15 million subscriptions and trials during its phased launch, and introduced a Model API, opening access to underlying model capabilities to developers and enterprises for the first time with a fee.

Muse targets consumers, Meta One bundles existing social products, and the Model API connects with enterprises and developers, creating three pathways that extend AI revenue from advertising into various paid scenarios.
Meta's massive user base is a key advantage for Muse's expansion. As of June 30, the family of apps—including Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp—had 3.6 billion daily active users.

If Muse can be embedded across these platforms, it doesn’t need to build distribution channels from scratch, a condition that other AI products that must earn downloads and usage time on their own cannot match.

However, for Muse to become a truly transactional agent it must clear the hurdle of third‑party platforms. A personal agent that completes shopping, travel or email tasks needs access to the websites users frequently use, and the more capable it is, the more it depends on whether external platforms are willing to open up.

Amazon (AMZN-US) has asked Meta to remove its shopping platform from the Muse experience, claiming Meta did not inform Amazon that Muse would access the Amazon store and that no authorization was given. Amazon also raised concerns about account data scraping and handling of sensitive information, insisting that third‑party AI should remain transparent and respect a platform's decision to participate.
Meta responded that Muse cannot see users' passwords or payment details; credentials are stored securely, and the agent can operate without viewing the content.
The differing positions highlight that as AI moves from answering questions to actual transactions, platform permissions and data‑access boundaries will become a new battleground.
Meta's annual Connect conference will take place on Wednesday local time, and the market expects the company may reveal more Muse usage data and new features.

With up to $145 billion in capital spending now a focal point for investors, active users, subscription conversion rates and task‑completion capability will be the key metrics to judge whether Meta's AI gamble truly pays off.

items.title: 美光成長速度將放緩 對股價反而是好消息？
items.title_en: Micron's Growth Rate Set to Slow – Good News for the Stock?
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，美光科技(Micron Technology)(MU-US)高速成長步伐可能很快就會放緩，但Stifel分析師認為不必擔心，這家記憶體晶片製造商短期成長速度雖然放慢，卻可能透過持續維持高價格與高利潤率來彌補。
美光股價周一(21日)上漲2.8%，收在1,044.34美元。投資人與分析師開始展望美光將於9月30日公布的第四季財報。
Stifel分析師Brian Chin周一在一份研究報告中寫道，「雖然我們預期美光公布的財報/財測將優於我們及市場共識預期……但我們預期，其超越預期的幅度將較近期幾季更為溫和。」
問題出在哪裡？很大程度上，其實只是因為美光及其同業無法以足夠快的速度出貨記憶體晶片，以滿足市場需求。Stifel預期，動態隨機存取記憶體(DRAM)出貨量在2027年將成長15%至20%，低於今年約20%中高段的成長幅度。
Chin預測，美光第四季營收將達507.8億美元，較前一季成長22%。他預期，這項季增幅將在目前一季放緩至11%。
但供應限制雖然可能抑制美光增加出貨量的能力，卻也可能讓價格與利潤維持在高檔。Stifel的Chin表示，2027年DRAM出貨量需要增加40%至50%，才能填補供需之間的缺口。
Chin寫道，「我們認為，考量目前記憶體位元需求的結構性成長速度，以及供給成長受到結構性限制的情況，市場仍未完全反映這檔股票的價值，而這些因素很可能在未來12至18個月以上，為公司帶來持續較高的價格/利潤率環境。」
這名Stifel分析師重申對美光股票的1,500美元目標價及買進評級。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that Micron Technology (MU‑US) may see its rapid growth pace slow soon, but Stifel analysts say there’s no cause for concern. The memory‑chip maker’s short‑term growth may decelerate, yet it could offset this by maintaining high prices and strong profit margins.
Micron’s shares rose 2.8% on Monday (the 21st), closing at $1,044.34. Investors and analysts are now looking ahead to Micron’s Q4 earnings report due on September 30.

Stifel analyst Brian Chin wrote in a research note on Monday, “While we expect Micron’s earnings and guidance to beat both our own and the market consensus… we anticipate the outperformance to be more modest than in recent quarters.”

What’s the issue? Largely, Micron and its peers cannot ship memory chips quickly enough to meet market demand. Stifel projects DRAM shipments to grow 15%‑20% in 2027, below the roughly 20% mid‑high range growth seen this year.
Chin forecasts Micron’s Q4 revenue at $50.78 billion, a 22% increase from the prior quarter. He expects the quarterly growth rate to slow to about 11% in the current quarter.

While supply constraints may curb Micron’s ability to increase shipments, they could also keep prices and margins elevated. Chin notes that DRAM shipments would need to rise 40%‑50% by 2027 to close the supply‑demand gap.

Chin writes, “Given the structural growth in memory‑bit demand and the structural limits on supply growth, the market has not fully priced in the stock’s value. These factors could sustain a higher price‑to‑margin environment for the company for the next 12‑18 months or more.”
The Stifel analyst reiterated a $1,500 price target for Micron stock and a buy rating.

items.title: 5兆至10兆參數！阿里巴巴打造超大AI模型「真武V900」性能較M890增3倍
items.title_en: 5‑to‑10‑Trillion‑Parameter AI Model! Alibaba Unveils Massive “Zhenwu V900” Chip, 3× Faster Than M890
paras: 阿里巴巴集團 (BABA-US)正加速布局人工智慧(AI)全棧技術, 執行長吳泳銘22日在杭州舉行的阿里雲年度Apsara大會上表示, 公司計畫訓練一款參數規模介於5兆至10兆的新AI模型, 規模將是目前旗艦模型的約2至4倍, 同時推出新一代AI晶片「真武V900」, 並大幅擴張全球資料中心容量, 顯示公司正從AI模型、晶片到算力基礎設施同步加碼。
吳泳銘表示, 阿里巴巴旗下Qwen團隊目前持續研究模型架構與資料最佳化, 新一代模型的目標是執行「更複雜、更長期」的任務, 並朝人工超級智慧(ASI)方向推進。他指出, 模型參數是AI在訓練過程中學習的變數, 通常可作為衡量模型規模的粗略指標。
目前阿里巴巴的旗艦模型Qwen 3.8 Max擁有2.4兆參數, 新模型若達5兆至10兆參數, 規模將是現有旗艦模型的約2至4倍。阿里巴巴同時表示, 旗下自研M890 AI超級節點目前已能處理超過2兆參數模型的推理工作, 吳泳銘稱, 全球目前具備這項能力的企業只有「少數幾家」。
除了擴大模型規模, Qwen團隊也在推進「遞迴自我改進」(recursive self-improvement)技術。吳泳銘表示, 團隊已取得「有意義的進展」, 相關技術讓模型能自行辨識限制、設計實驗並整合資料, 進而形成持續自我演化的循環。
阿里巴巴此次也公布新一代AI晶片真武V900, 由旗下半導體設計子公司平頭哥(T-Head)開發。吳泳銘稱,V900是中國目前功能最強大的AI晶片, 單顆晶片的性能是前一代M890的3倍。
根據阿里巴巴公布的規畫, 以V900打造的單一叢集最多可支援50萬張卡, 用於前沿AI模型的訓練與推理。吳泳銘並表示, 公司預期AI晶片年度出貨量將出現「顯著成長」。
這項晶片布局正值中國科技業加速尋找國產AI運算替代方案之際。美國持續對先進AI晶片對中國出口實施限制, 促使中國企業加大自主晶片研發力度。全球AI運算市場目前仍由輝達 (NVDA-US)等美國晶片企業主導, 中國企業則積極建立從AI晶片、模型到資料中心的自主供應鏈。
阿里巴巴此前已將自研晶片視為AI戰略的重要組成部分。今年5月, 公司推出M890 AI晶片, 宣稱性能為前一代Zhenwu 810E的3倍, 並搭配Panjiu AL128伺服器, 單一機架可整合128個AI加速器。平頭哥當時表示, 已出貨超過56萬顆Zhenwu系列晶片, 超過400家外部客戶、涵蓋20個產業採用相關產品。
阿里巴巴此次公布的另一項重要目標是資料中心。吳泳銘表示, 公司計畫將阿里雲全球資料中心總容量提高至2032年超過20GW, 以支撐未來AI模型訓練、推理及企業客戶需求。
他指出, 客戶對AI的需求仍然「異常強勁」, 並正在加速阿里雲營收成長, 但全球AI資料中心供應鏈目前存在短缺, 限制公司擴大基礎設施的速度。吳泳銘表示, AI產業中長期需求「遠遠超過」目前的供應能力, 阿里雲將從今年第3季開始, 大規模商業化部署AI超級節點。
阿里巴巴近年已投入巨額資金擴大AI與雲端運算能力。公司此前宣布, 未來3年將投入超過3,800億元人民幣(約530億美元)於雲端及AI基礎設施, 是公司歷來最大規模的相關投資承諾。
AI已成為阿里巴巴雲端業務的重要成長動能。公司今年3月公布的資料顯示, 截至2025年12月的季度, 雲端智能集團營收年增36%至432.84億元人民幣(約61.9億美元), AI相關產品營收已連續第10季維持三位數成長。Qwen系列模型截至今年1月21日在Hugging Face的累計下載量已突破10億次, 而Qwen App截至2月所有平台月活躍用戶超過3億。
此次公布的新模型規模, 也反映阿里巴巴對AI模型能力發展方向的判斷。吳泳銘認為, AI產業正在進入「機器智慧」時代, 其影響可能類似工業革命。他預測, 未來機器產生的「思考」量最終可能超過全人類總和的1,000倍, 而目前機器所產生的相關「思考」量還不到人類的3%。
吳泳銘並將AI程式設計比喻為電氣時代的燈泡, 認為這只是機器智慧時代早期出現的應用, 而非真正的突破性產品。他表示, 真正具有顛覆性的「機器智慧」時代產品目前尚未出現。
阿里巴巴此次同時推進超大型模型、自研AI晶片及全球資料中心, 顯示其AI戰略已從單純開發模型, 擴大至涵蓋模型訓練、晶片供應、算力部署及商業化服務的完整技術鏈。隨著新模型參數規模可能達到10兆, V900性能較M890提升3倍, 以及全球資料中心容量朝20GW以上擴張, 阿里巴巴正試圖建立足以支撐下一階段AI發展的完整算力體系。
paras_en: Alibaba Group (BABA‑US) is accelerating its full‑stack AI strategy. CEO Daniel Zhang said at the Alibaba Cloud Apsara Conference in Hangzhou that the company plans to train a new AI model with 5‑to‑10 trillion parameters—about two to four times the size of its current flagship model—and will launch the next‑generation AI chip “Zhenwu V900” while vastly expanding global data‑center capacity, indicating simultaneous investments in models, chips and compute infrastructure.

Zhang explained that Alibaba’s Qwen team is continuing research on model architecture and data optimization. The new model aims to handle “more complex, longer‑term” tasks and move toward artificial superintelligence (ASI). He noted that model parameters are the variables learned during training and serve as a rough gauge of model scale.

Alibaba’s flagship model Qwen 3.8 Max has 2.4 trillion parameters. A model with 5‑to‑10 trillion parameters would be roughly two to four times larger. Alibaba also said its in‑house M890 AI supernode can already run inference for models exceeding 2 trillion parameters, and Zhang claimed only a handful of companies worldwide possess this capability.

Beyond scaling models, the Qwen team is advancing “recursive self‑improvement” technology. Zhang said the team has made “meaningful progress,” enabling the model to identify its own limitations, design experiments, and integrate data, creating a continuous self‑evolution loop.

Alibaba also announced the new Zhenwu V900 AI chip, developed by its semiconductor design subsidiary T‑Head. Zhang called the V900 the most powerful AI chip in China, with a single‑chip performance three times that of the previous‑generation M890.

According to Alibaba’s roadmap, a single V900‑based cluster can support up to 500,000 cards for cutting‑edge AI model training and inference. Zhang added that the company expects a “significant” year‑over‑year increase in AI‑chip shipments.

This chip push comes as China’s tech sector races to find domestic AI‑compute alternatives amid ongoing U.S. export restrictions on advanced AI chips. The global AI‑compute market remains dominated by U.S. firms such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US), while Chinese firms are building an end‑to‑end supply chain from chips to models to data centers.

Alibaba has long treated its self‑developed chips as a core part of its AI strategy. In May, it launched the M890 chip, claiming three‑fold performance over the prior Zhenwu 810E and pairing it with Panjiu AL128 servers that pack 128 AI accelerators per rack. T‑Head said it had shipped over 560,000 Zhenwu‑series chips to more than 400 external customers across 20 industries.

Another key goal announced is data‑center capacity. Zhang said Alibaba Cloud plans to raise its total global data‑center capacity to over 20 GW by 2032 to support future AI model training, inference and enterprise demand.

He noted that customer demand for AI remains “exceptionally strong,” driving Alibaba Cloud revenue growth, but a global shortage of AI data‑center supply chain components is limiting infrastructure expansion. Zhang said long‑term AI demand “far exceeds” current supply, and Alibaba Cloud will begin large‑scale commercial deployment of AI supernodes starting in Q3 this year.

Alibaba has poured massive capital into AI and cloud computing in recent years. The company previously announced a three‑year investment of more than 380 billion yuan (about $53 billion) in cloud and AI infrastructure—the largest commitment in its history.

AI has become a major growth engine for Alibaba Cloud. Data released in March showed that for the quarter ending December 2025, the Cloud Intelligence Group’s revenue grew 36% year‑over‑year to 43.284 billion yuan (≈$6.19 billion), with AI‑related product revenue posting double‑digit growth for the 10th consecutive quarter. Qwen models had surpassed 1 billion cumulative downloads on Hugging Face by Jan 21, and the Qwen App recorded over 300 million monthly active users across platforms as of February.

The announced model size reflects Alibaba’s view of AI development direction. Zhang believes the AI industry is entering a “machine intelligence” era, whose impact could be comparable to the Industrial Revolution. He predicts that future machine‑generated “thinking” could eventually exceed humanity’s total by a factor of 1,000, while today machines account for less than 3% of human‑level thinking.

Zhang likened AI programming to the light bulb of the electrical age, saying it is an early‑stage application of machine intelligence rather than a truly breakthrough product. He added that genuinely disruptive “machine‑intelligence” products have yet to appear.

Alibaba’s simultaneous push on ultra‑large models, self‑developed AI chips and global data‑center expansion shows its AI strategy has evolved from pure model development to a full‑stack chain covering model training, chip supply, compute deployment and commercial services. With model parameters potentially reaching 10 trillion, V900 performance three times that of M890, and data‑center capacity expanding beyond 20 GW, Alibaba aims to build a complete compute ecosystem to support the next phase of AI development.

items.title_en: Muse Tops Download Charts; AMD Market Cap Breaks $1 Trillion! Institutions: CPU Becomes Core of AI Agents; End-User AI and Compute Demand Enters Real Pull Phase
paras: Meta推出的AI智能體應用程式Muse上線後迅速登頂蘋果應用商店免費榜，引發市場對AI應用大規模落地將拉動伺服器CPU等晶片需求的樂觀預期，美股費城半導體指數周一(21日)因此大漲4.29%，Meta飆漲11.43%，超微市值首度突破1兆美元，並在今(22)日直接催化A股端側AI、算力及半導體類股走強。
算力方面，華為昇騰960系列晶片提前完成研發準備，整體效能翻倍提升，昇騰960DT將於明年Q1正式推出，較原先規劃提早三個季度。
銀河證券指出，中國國產算力晶片研發能力正在加速，下游需求旺盛，預計加速放量。東吳證券也強調，全球首個NPO超節點提前發布，中國國產算力加速落地，帶來先進製程、先進封測設備新需求，算力放量加上「韜定律」有望打開測試環節數倍成長空間。
華源證券表示，隨著中國國內AI大模型進入加速發展期，國產超節點憑藉高密度整合、高速互聯、全局協同的核心優勢，可望實現量產與滲透率提升，持續看好高景氣度的國產算力板塊。
另據萬聯證券，隨著AI普及和基礎設施投資大幅成長，半導體設備需求水漲船高，海外零件交期拉長，中國國產零件廠迎來機會。南韓科技媒體《ETNEWS》報導指出，半導體製造設備關鍵零件的交貨週期已延長一倍以上。
材料方面，銀河證券指出，日本JSR、東京應化、信越化學等宣布下月起全球客戶光阻新定價整體上調15%，先進製程光阻國產化率低，相關企業進展值得關注。
晶圓代工方面，產業龍頭台積電近期向設備與材料夥伴揭露2027年中期擴產規劃，2奈米製程月產能將從今年底的9萬片提升至2027年中的11萬片，3奈米製程從逾18萬片提升至21萬片，為歷來最大規模先進製程中期擴建。
記憶體方面，國盛證券指出，目前中國國產記憶體擴產主體進一步增多，除長鑫、長江存儲外，晉華重回擴產軌道。長鑫新一代製程平台國產設備佔比可望超過40%、長江三期國產設備採購佔比突破50%，國內設備及零件廠商可望持續受益
開源證券表示，HBM迭代帶動單晶片容量及晶圓投入提升，產能向高附加價值產品集中，加上新增產能釋放週期較長，記憶體價格與供應商議價能力獲得支撐。
財通證券則說，AI晶片功耗與熱流密度持續抬升，近端散熱材料升級成為確定性方向。GPU功耗由A100約400W、H100約700W提升至GB200的大約1200W，Rubin進一步向2000W以上演進，局部熱點熱流密度向1000W/cm²以上提升。
paras_en: After its launch, Meta's AI agent app Muse quickly rose to the top of Apple's free App Store chart, sparking optimistic expectations that large‑scale AI applications will drive demand for server CPUs and other chips. Consequently, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 4.29% on Monday (the 21st), Meta surged 11.43%, AMD’s market value broke the $1 trillion mark for the first time, and the news directly boosted AI, compute and semiconductor stocks on the A‑share market on the 22nd.

In the compute arena, Huawei’s Ascend 960 series chips have completed R&D ahead of schedule, delivering double the performance. The Ascend 960DT is slated for official launch in Q1 of next year, three quarters earlier than originally planned.

Galaxy Securities noted that China’s domestic compute‑chip development capability is accelerating, with strong downstream demand expected to speed up volume ramp‑up. Dongwu Securities also highlighted that the world’s first NPO super‑node was released early, accelerating the rollout of Chinese compute chips and creating new demand for advanced process and advanced packaging‑testing equipment; the scaling of compute capacity combined with “Moore’s Law” could open up several‑fold growth in the testing segment.

Huayuan Securities said that as China’s domestic AI large‑model sector enters an acceleration phase, home‑grown super‑nodes, thanks to their high‑density integration, high‑speed interconnects and global coordination advantages, are poised for mass production and higher penetration, keeping a bullish outlook on the high‑growth domestic compute sector.

According to Wanlian Securities, the rapid spread of AI and booming infrastructure investment are driving semiconductor equipment demand to soar, while overseas component lead times are lengthening, presenting opportunities for Chinese component makers. South Korean tech media ETNEWS reported that delivery cycles for key semiconductor manufacturing parts have more than doubled.

On the materials side, Galaxy Securities pointed out that Japanese firms JSR, TOK (Tokyo Ohka Kogyo), and Shin-Etsu Chemical announced a 15% price increase for photoresist for global customers starting next month. Since the domestic substitution rate for advanced‑process photoresist is low, the progress of these companies warrants attention.

In wafer foundry news, industry leader TSMC recently disclosed to equipment and material partners its mid‑term expansion plan through 2027: 2‑nm monthly capacity will rise from 90,000 wafers at the end of this year to 110,000 wafers by mid‑2027, and 3‑nm capacity will increase from over 180,000 to 210,000 wafers, marking the largest mid‑term expansion of advanced processes to date.

Regarding memory, Guosheng Securities noted that China’s domestic memory expansion players are increasing, with companies such as ChangXin, Yangtze Memory and JinHua returning to expansion tracks. The new‑generation process platform of ChangXin could see domestic equipment share exceed 40%, while Yangtze’s Phase‑3 domestic equipment procurement could break 50%, allowing local equipment and component firms to continue benefiting.

OpenSource Securities said that HBM iterations are driving higher chip‑die capacity and wafer consumption, concentrating production on higher‑value‑added products. With new capacity release cycles being relatively long, memory prices and supplier bargaining power are being supported.

Caitong Securities stated that AI chip power consumption and thermal‑flux density keep rising, making near‑end cooling material upgrades a definite trend. GPU power draw has risen from about 400 W for the A100 and 700 W for the H100 to roughly 1,200 W for the GB200, with Rubin moving toward over 2,000 W, and localized hotspot thermal‑flux density exceeding 1,000 W/cm².

items.title: 警訊浮現！標普500強勢攻高 為什麼近6成成分股悄悄進入熊市？
items.title_en: Alert Signals Appear! S&P 500 Races Higher—Why Nearly 60% of Its Components Have Quietly Slipped Into a Bear Market?
paras: 在科技股及其他人工智慧(AI)概念股帶動下，標普500指數正直逼先前創下的歷史新高，但亮麗的表現背後出現令人擔憂的趨勢：近六成成分股與歷史高點相比跌逾20%——換句話說，參與股市漲勢的股票比例正在縮小。
根據道瓊市場數據，標普500指數周一(21日)收盤距離8月13日創下的歷史收盤高點7798.99點僅差0.4%。與此同時，那斯達克綜合指數同日收盤突破6月初創下的前一波高點27093.90點。

大型科技股領漲 AMD股價飆近10%

經歷一段表現溫吞的行情後，Meta(META-US)在內的「科技七巨頭」(Magnificent Seven)中的大型科技股周一重新扮演重要推手。半導體股、記憶體股及硬體股也大幅走高，超微(AMD-US)股價飆升9.95%。
這波漲勢凸顯企業獲利驚人增長的吸引力，以及未來幾年AI建設可望每年帶來約1兆美元資本支出的龐大投資熱潮。
然而股市表面之下仍存在弱勢，關稅、通膨、能源價格飆升及借貸成本上升，都已對市場造成壓力。
Ameriprise首席市場策略師Anthony Saglimbene說：「市場廣度實際上已經惡化，儘管指數正逐步逼近歷史新高。」他指的是目前參與股市漲勢的股票比例正在縮小。
Saglimbene表示，儘管AI概念股重新受到市場青睞，但公用事業股表現疲弱，非必需消費品類股也面臨壓力，包括汽車零組件、紡織品及精品相關股票，「很多股票都遠低於52周高點。」

標普逼近新高 逾半成分股卻跌逾20%

儘管標普500指數重新逼近8月高點，但根據道瓊市場數據，標普500成分股中有59.2%較歷史高點下跌至少20%。
華爾街許多人將從歷史高點下跌至少20%視為進入熊市的定義。不過，許多重挫的標普500成分股近期波動劇烈，幾個月內就可能出現20%甚至更大的漲跌幅。
根據道瓊市場數據，至少自2017年底以來，標普500指數從未在距離歷史高點不到1%的同時，還有如此高比例的成分股較自己曾創下的歷史高點下跌20%以上。這也是2022年10月這波多頭行情啟動以來，首度出現這種情況。
不過，雖然有些投資人認為這反映市場潛在風險，但也有一派認為這顯示市場仍具韌性。
富蘭克林坦伯頓研究所(Franklin Templeton Institute)資深市場策略師Chris Galipeau表示，一般人可能會認為「事情會開始失控」，例如汽油與柴油價格飆升、伊朗戰爭，以及聯準會(Fed)實現2%通膨目標的公信力遭質疑等問題。
但Galipeau表示，今年前六個月美國經濟與企業獲利的韌性都超出預期，「這個故事很被難反駁」，除非Fed最終大幅升息並拖累經濟成長。

油價與高殖利率仍是市場隱憂

儘管如此，伊朗戰爭、10年期美國公債殖利率接近5%，以及Fed重新強化抗通膨立場，都影響目前投資人的資金配置方向。
美國汽油價格目前每加侖衝上4.50美元，柴油價格也達到創紀錄的每加侖6.50美元，同時生活成本及借貸成本也持續上升。
然而，即使Fed升息一次或數次，預料也不太會阻止超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)繼續為AI大舉投資。
Schwab金融研究中心宏觀經濟研究與策略主管Kevin Gordon說：「這一直是一個大規模的資金輪動過程。但對我而言，這就是今年市場的本質。你會看到某些產業與類股出現一段時間的疲弱，但不會所有產業同時走弱。」
全球基準布蘭特原油價格這三個月來上漲約25%，重新回到每桶100美元，加劇了許多家庭的生活成本危機。
然而，標普500中的許多能源股仍在接近歷史高點的位置交易，包括馬拉松石油(MPC-US)、Valero Energy(VLO-US)及Phillips 66(PSX-US)。這些個股周一都收黑，跌幅在4-5%之間。
Gordon形容，市場目前呈現「謹慎攀越憂慮之牆」的格局。
paras_en: Driven by tech stocks and other artificial‑intelligence (AI) concept shares, the S&P 500 index is closing in on its previous all‑time high, but a worrying trend lurks behind the shine: almost six‑tenths of its components have fallen more than 20% from their historic peaks—meaning the share of stocks participating in the market rally is shrinking.

According to Dow Jones market data, the S&P 500 closed on Monday (the 21st) just 0.4% shy of the August 13 record closing high of 7,798.99 points. At the same time, the Nasdaq Composite also broke through its early‑June peak of 27,093.90 points on the same day.

Large‑cap tech leads the surge – AMD jumps nearly 10% After a period of tepid performance, the “Magnificent Seven” tech giants, including Meta (META‑US), returned to the forefront on Monday. Semiconductor, memory and hardware stocks also rallied sharply, with AMD (AMD‑US) soaring 9.95%.

The rally underscores the appeal of astonishing corporate profit growth and the massive investment wave expected as AI build‑out could drive roughly $1 trillion of capital spending each year over the next few years.
Nevertheless, weakness remains beneath the market’s surface: tariffs, inflation, soaring energy prices and rising borrowing costs have all put pressure on equities.

Ameriprise chief market strategist Anthony Saglimbene said, “Market breadth has actually deteriorated even as the index inches toward a new high.” He is referring to the shrinking proportion of stocks that are joining the rally.

Saglimbene noted that while AI‑related stocks have regained favor, utility shares are lagging and non‑essential consumer stocks – including auto parts, textiles and luxury‑related equities – are under pressure, with “many stocks far below their 52‑week highs.”

S&P nears new high but over half its components are down more than 20% Even as the S&P 500 closes in on the August peak, Dow Jones data show that 59.2% of its constituents are at least 20% below their historic highs.

Many on Wall Street treat a drop of 20% or more from a historic high as the definition of a bear market. Yet many heavily‑hit S&P 500 stocks have been extremely volatile lately and could swing 20% or more within a few months.

Dow Jones data indicate that, at least since the end of 2017, the S&P 500 has never been within 1% of its all‑time high while simultaneously having such a high share of components down more than 20% from their own peaks. This is the first time this has happened since the bullish run that began in October 2022.
Some investors see this as a sign of underlying risk, while others argue it shows the market’s resilience.

Franklin Templeton Institute senior market strategist Chris Galipeau said most people might think “things are getting out of control,” citing soaring gasoline and diesel prices, the Iran war, and doubts about the Fed’s credibility in hitting a 2% inflation target.

Galipeau added that U.S. economic and corporate earnings resilience in the first six months of the year has exceeded expectations, “this story is hard to refute” unless the Fed ultimately raises rates sharply enough to drag down growth.

Oil prices and high yields remain market worries Nonetheless, the Iran conflict, the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield hovering near 5%, and the Fed’s renewed anti‑inflation stance are shaping investors’ asset‑allocation decisions.
U.S. gasoline is now around $4.50 per gallon and diesel has hit a record $6.50 per gallon, while living‑cost and borrowing pressures continue to rise.
Even if the Fed hikes rates once or a few times, it is unlikely to halt hyperscalers from continuing massive AI investments.

Kevin Gordon, head of macro‑economic research and strategy at Schwab’s research center, said, “It’s been a massive capital‑rotation process. To me, that’s the essence of this year’s market. You’ll see some sectors and groups weaken for a spell, but not all sectors will falter together.”
Global benchmark Brent crude has risen about 25% over the past three months, returning to $100 a barrel and intensifying cost‑of‑living crises for many households.

Nevertheless, many energy stocks in the S&P 500 are still trading near historic highs, including Marathon Petroleum (MPC‑US), Valero Energy (VLO‑US) and Phillips 66 (PSX‑US). All three closed in the red on Monday, slipping 4‑5%.
Gordon described the market’s current state as a “cautious climb over a wall of concern.”

items.title: 馬斯克聯手輝達押注軌道AI！100萬顆衛星上限已申請  太空機房要比星鏈大百倍
items.title_en: Musk Teams with Nvidia to Bet on Orbital AI! 1 Million Satellite Cap Already Applied, Space Data Centers to Be Hundreds of Times Larger Than Starlink
paras: 矽谷知名投資人、巴倫資本創辦人Ron Baron上周四(17日)在面向客戶的投資人大會上，系統地推廣馬斯克旗下軌道AI專案「Starmind(星智)」。
Baron把太空資料中心的成本邏輯概括為：地面資料中心是「10美元資本投入加每年2美元維護運作」，太空則是「一次性2美元」；衛星每5年換一代、效能提升10倍，10年內容量可翻100倍，未來每年能湊出100GW電力。不過，這些數據均來自Baron個人表述，而非第三方審計結論。
監理端與工程端的進展則是有據可查。美國聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)今年2月4日發佈公開通知，接受SpaceX的軌道資料中心系統申請並徵求公眾意見。
文件顯示，SpaceX今年1月30日申請在500至2000公里高度的近地軌道部署最多100萬顆衛星，運行於30度及太陽同步軌道傾角，主要依靠星間光鏈路互聯，並可連接第一代、第二代星鏈衛星。同時，SpaceX在申請中請求豁免NGSO部署進度節點、保證金等義務，並要求免於按處理輪次申請18.3—19.3GHz及28.6—29.1GHz頻段。
需要區分的是，100萬顆是向FCC申請的系統規模上限，不等於實際部署量。星鏈當年申請4.2萬顆、實際在軌約1萬顆，申請規模預留未來餘裕為航太業慣例。
賓州大學教授Benjamin C. Lee先前公開表示，目前全球在軌衛星合計約1.5萬顆。此外，申請文件未揭露衛星尺寸、重量、具體軌道參數、部署時間表與成本預估，技術細節缺失仍是監管與產業界的核心質疑。
與輝達的合作關係已由官方確認。輝達上月24日宣布，SpaceXAI計畫將加速運算能力延伸至太空，第一代Starmind AI衛星將基於優化後的輝達Vera Rubin NVL72機架級系統構建，雙方正共同適配軌道運算在供電、熱管理、頻寬、可靠性與物理整合上的約束。
SpaceX在財報電話會議上指出，未來所有AI算力將獨家採用輝達架構，首顆AI衛星計畫於今年第四季發射，2028年達到顯著規模
成本與資本開支是爭議最集中的環節。伍德麥肯錫(Wood Mackenzie)在報告中估算，一個假設性的1GW軌道資料中心造價約1700億美元，是地面同等設施的3倍以上，其中發射與衛星成本約佔總成本的60%，但要將軌道成本降至與地面持平，需實現70%的成本降幅。
伍德麥肯錫基準情境甚至未納入大規模軌道資料中心，明確指出其目前仍是「對成本曲線的押注」。
資本開支方面，摩根士丹利分析師Adam Jonas預估，SpaceX 2026年AI相關資本支出約530億美元，2027年約1300億美元，折合每瓦約40美元。支援方認為，軌道資料中心可規避地面設施的監管障礙與社區阻力，星艦推動的發射成本下降將持續改善經濟性。
但批評人士指出，昂貴的AI晶片與高昂的發射成本仍是現實門檻，現階段經濟模型尚未跑通。
另有投行給予較樂觀的長線判斷，認為SpaceX到2031年底可部署約75GW軌道算力，成本顯著低於地面建設，可望成為其發射與星鏈業務以外的新營收來源。
paras_en: Silicon Valley investor and Baren Capital founder Ron Baron promoted Elon Musk’s orbital AI project “Starmind” to clients at a conference on Thursday, the 17th.

Baron summarized the cost logic of space data centers as: a ground data center costs $10 in capital plus $2 per year in operating expenses, while space costs a one‑time $2; satellites are refreshed every five years with ten‑fold performance gains, yielding a hundred‑fold increase in capacity over ten years and the ability to generate 100 GW of power annually. These figures come from Baron’s own statements, not third‑party audits.

Regulatory and engineering progress can be verified. The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) issued a public notice on February 4, accepting SpaceX’s orbital data‑center system application and seeking public comment.

The filing shows SpaceX applied on Jan 30 to deploy up to 1 million satellites in low‑Earth orbit at 500‑2,000 km, operating at 30° and sun‑synchronous inclinations, primarily linked via inter‑satellite optical links and compatible with first‑ and second‑generation Starlink satellites. SpaceX also requested waivers for NGSO deployment milestones, security deposits and exemption from filing for the 18.3‑19.3 GHz and 28.6‑29.1 GHz bands on a per‑round basis.

It should be noted that the 1 million figure is the maximum system size requested from the FCC, not the actual deployment count. Starlink originally applied for 42,000 satellites but has about 10,000 in orbit, a common practice of reserving future capacity in the aerospace industry.

University of Pennsylvania professor Benjamin C. Lee has previously stated that roughly 15,000 satellites are currently in orbit worldwide. The application does not disclose satellite size, mass, exact orbital parameters, deployment schedule or cost estimates, leaving technical details a core concern for regulators and the industry.

The partnership with Nvidia has been confirmed by officials. Nvidia announced on the 24th of last month that the SpaceX AI project will extend compute power to space, with the first‑generation Starmind AI satellites built on an optimized Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 rack‑level system, and both parties are jointly adapting orbital computing to constraints in power, thermal management, bandwidth, reliability and physical integration.

SpaceX said in its earnings call that all future AI compute will exclusively use Nvidia architecture, with the first AI satellite slated for launch in Q4 this year and a significant scale expected by 2028.

Cost and capital expenditure are the most contentious issues. Wood Mackenzie estimated in a report that a hypothetical 1 GW orbital data center would cost about $170 billion, more than three times the cost of an equivalent ground facility, with launch and satellite costs accounting for roughly 60 % of total cost; a 70 % cost reduction would be needed to bring orbital costs in line with ground‑based ones.
Wood Mackenzie’s baseline scenario does not even include a large‑scale orbital data center, explicitly stating that it remains a bet on the cost curve.

On the cap‑ex side, Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Jonas projects SpaceX’s AI‑related capital spending at about $53 billion in 2026 and $130 billion in 2027, roughly $40 per watt. Proponents argue that orbital data centers avoid ground‑based regulatory hurdles and community opposition, and that the cost reductions from Starship launches will continue to improve economics.
Critics counter that expensive AI chips and high launch costs remain real barriers, and that the economic model is not yet proven.

Some investment banks are more optimistic long‑term, estimating SpaceX could have roughly 75 GW of orbital compute capacity deployed by the end of 2031, at costs significantly lower than ground construction, potentially becoming a new revenue stream beyond its launch and Starlink businesses.

items.title: 比爾蓋茲警告：AI就像人造外星人 不能再當普通科技看待
items.title_en: Bill Gates Warns: AI Is Like Man‑Made Aliens, No Longer a Ordinary Technology
paras: 比爾蓋茲近日表示，人工智慧（AI）與過往所有技術都不一樣，若僅將其視為既有科技的延續，恐怕容易掉以輕心。他更將AI發展比喻為「外星人降臨」，強調這些「外星人」不是搭乘太空船而來，而是由人類親手創造，並被置入電腦之中。
蓋茲在紐約出席基金會目標守衛者會議時指出，他原本希望自己只需要談論對外援助，以及如何降低兒童死亡率，但AI快速發展，使他在與各國領導人會面時，不得不同時討論另一項迫切問題：社會是否已為這場變革做好準備，以及如何面對技術可能帶來的風險。
AI進展之快，約在一年前便讓蓋茲感到震驚。他指出，AI如今已能完成程式設計工作，而這項技能是他年輕時花費大量時間才得以掌握。
AI不僅可以編寫程式碼，也能研究程式碼、找出漏洞，甚至可能被用來入侵各類系統，展現出的能力已超越單純提升效率的工具。
不過，真正令蓋茲擔憂的並非只有技術本身，而是社會尚未對AI的指數級進步展開足夠廣泛的參與和討論。
科技業內部雖已開始探討相關風險，但更廣泛的大眾仍未充分投入，社會對這項技術的理解與準備，明顯落後於AI演進速度。
蓋茲形容，當前的改變就像「十本科幻小說裡的情節同時發生」。傳統科幻作品通常只圍繞一項重大技術突破展開，但AI可能同時推動多個領域快速變革，因此不能再以過往看待單一科技創新的方式加以理解。
他強調，AI極為特殊，人類未來將走向何方，取決於如何對待這項技術。因應AI挑戰的第一步，是讓更多人參與其中，不僅成為技術的使用者，也要了解背後潛藏的風險，避免AI議題只停留在科技產業內部。
蓋茲也提醒，AI具有明顯的兩面性。一方面，它可望在農業與公共衛生領域推動創新；另一方面，也可能帶來難以忽視的安全風險。如何合理運用AI、同時建立對風險的認識，將成為社會必須共同面對的課題。
談及全球發展時，蓋茲對部分富裕國家削減對低收入國家的援助表示遺憾。他指出，在經濟持續成長、企業獲利屢創新高之際，許多富裕國家的政府卻變得更加吝嗇。
他並非要求世界的一部分拯救另一部分，而是主張透過慷慨投入推動共同進步，協助資源匱乏、仍努力挽救生命的社區。
蓋茲呼籲恢復資金支持，以保障最基本的生存需求。他認為，若能將更多公益投入與AI的合理運用相結合，便有機會加快實現全球公平的目標。
paras_en: Bill Gates recently said that artificial intelligence (AI) is unlike any technology before; treating it merely as a continuation of existing tech could lead to complacency. He likened AI development to “aliens arriving,” emphasizing that these “aliens” aren’t coming in spaceships but are created by humans and embedded in computers.

Speaking at the Foundation’s Guardians of the Goal conference in New York, Gates noted that he originally hoped to talk only about foreign aid and how to reduce child mortality, but the rapid advance of AI forced him, when meeting world leaders, to also discuss a pressing issue: whether society is ready for this transformation and how to confront the risks the technology may bring.
The speed of AI progress shocked Gates about a year ago. He pointed out that AI can now perform programming tasks—a skill he spent a great deal of time mastering when he was younger.
AI can not only write code but also analyze it, find vulnerabilities, and could even be used to breach various systems, showing capabilities that go beyond being a simple efficiency‑boosting tool.
However, what truly worries Gates is not just the technology itself but the fact that society has not engaged broadly enough in discussion about AI’s exponential advancement.

While the tech industry has begun to explore related risks, the wider public remains insufficiently involved; society’s understanding and preparation for this technology lag clearly behind the pace of AI’s evolution.

Gates described the current change as “ten sci‑fi novel plots happening at once.” Traditional sci‑fi usually focuses on a single breakthrough, but AI may drive rapid transformation across multiple fields simultaneously, so it can no longer be understood through the lens of past single‑technology innovations.

He stressed that AI is exceptionally unique, and humanity’s future direction depends on how we treat it. The first step in meeting AI’s challenges is to involve more people—not just as users of the technology but also as aware of its hidden risks—to prevent AI discussions from staying confined to the tech industry.

Gates also warned that AI has a clear dual nature. On one hand, it promises innovation in agriculture and public health; on the other, it poses significant security risks. Balancing sensible AI use with risk awareness will become a societal issue that must be tackled together.

When speaking about global development, Gates expressed regret over some wealthy nations cutting aid to low‑income countries. He noted that while economies keep growing and corporate profits hit record highs, many rich‑country governments are becoming more stingy.
He is not calling for one part of the world to rescue another, but advocates generous investment to drive shared progress, helping resource‑poor communities that are still striving to save lives.

Gates urged the restoration of funding to secure basic survival needs. He believes that if more philanthropy is combined with responsible AI deployment, there is an opportunity to accelerate the achievement of global equity.

items.title: 地緣政治緊張推升原油期貨 Meta AI熱潮助攻亞洲股市
items.title_en: Geopolitical Tensions Lift Crude Oil Futures, Meta AI Hype Boosts Asian Stocks
paras: 地緣政治情勢發展與人工智慧(AI)需求增溫，同時成為周二(22日)影響國際原油價格與亞洲股市走勢的主因。

美伊會談前景不明

受市場對本周聯合國大會期間美伊會談的樂觀情緒減退影響，國際原油期貨價格周二走高。根據洲際交易所(ICE)數據，近月布蘭特原油期貨上漲 1.6%，收在每桶 101.99 美元；近月西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨上揚 1.7%，收在每桶 97.40 美元。
各國領袖本周齊聚位於紐約的聯合國大會，美國總統川普與伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)均預定發表演說，川普還計畫於紐約期間與多位中東領袖會面。
多位外交官指出，卡達官員擬利用此次大會場合，討論重啟美伊對話的可能性。不過外交圈與市場普遍認為，由於大會期間尚未確認會舉行正式的美伊雙邊會談，因此出現重大突破的機會不高。

Meta AI代理引發關注

在科技股與大盤表現方面，亞股周二普遍上揚。台灣加權指數在IC與半導體類股領漲帶動下，盤中一度創下歷史新高，最終收盤上漲 0.2%。南韓綜合股價指數(Kospi)早盤走高後回吐部分漲幅，終場收升 0.25%。
此波股市漲勢主要來自市場對晶片需求的樂觀情緒增強。美國科技巨頭 Meta Platforms 推出的全新 AI 代理(AI agent)引發市場高度關注，進一步激勵全球 AI 概念股表現。其中，晶片製造龍頭 SK 海力士與三星電子占據南韓 Kospi 指數約 50% 的市值，成為撐盤的主要動能。
日股仍處連假期間，將繼續休市至周三。
paras_en: Geopolitical developments and rising demand for artificial intelligence (AI) were the main drivers on Tuesday the 22nd of international crude oil prices and Asian equity market movements.

Uncertainty over a US‑Iran dialogue. With optimism fading about a possible US‑Iran talks during this week’s United Nations General Assembly, international crude oil futures rose on Tuesday. According to Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) data, the near‑month Brent crude futures gained 1.6% to $101.99 a barrel, while the near‑month West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures climbed 1.7% to $97.40 a barrel.

World leaders gathered this week at the UN General Assembly in New York, where US President Donald Trump and Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian are scheduled to deliver speeches, and Trump also plans to meet several Middle‑East leaders while in New York.

Several diplomats said Qatari officials intend to use the assembly as a venue to discuss the possibility of restarting US‑Iran talks. However, both diplomatic circles and the market generally believe that, since no formal bilateral US‑Iran meeting has been confirmed for the summit, the chance of a breakthrough is low.

Meta AI agent draws attention. In terms of tech stocks and broader market performance, Asian equities rose overall on Tuesday. Taiwan’s weighted index, led by IC and semiconductor stocks, briefly hit a historic high intraday and closed up 0.2%. South Korea’s Kospi index rose early before giving back some gains, ending the session up 0.25%.

The rally was mainly driven by heightened optimism about chip demand. The launch of a brand‑new AI agent by US tech giant Meta Platforms sparked strong market interest, further boosting global AI‑themed stocks. Leading chip makers SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics, which together account for about 50% of the Kospi’s market cap, were the main support for the market.
Japanese stocks remain on holiday during the consecutive‑day break and will stay closed until Wednesday.

items.title: AI先進封裝需求延續至2028年產能增速高於雲端Capex、供需缺口成觀察重點
items.title_en: AI Advanced Packaging Demand Extends to 2028, Capacity Growth Outpaces Cloud Capex, Supply‑Demand Gap Becomes a Key Focus
paras: 2026年09月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI晶片對先進封裝需求預估延續至2028年，即使雲端服務供應商(CSP)資本支出增速放慢，先進封裝產能仍將快速擴張。Morgan Stanley最新預估，2028年先進封裝總產能可成長約50%，明顯高於同期CSP資本支出約12%的增幅。
需求成長除了來自AI伺服器持續擴建，也與單顆晶片使用更多先進封裝產能有關。隨AI晶片尺寸放大，加上CPU與網路處理器增加採用先進封裝，市場對封裝產能的需求增幅可能高於整體資料中心資本支出。
ASIC也是另一項需求來源。AI客製化晶片開發活動維持強勁，新合作案與推論應用持續增加，使先進封裝需求逐步由GPU擴大至ASIC、CPU及網路處理器。供應鏈調查顯示，台積電(2330-TW)及合作夥伴仍持續擴充相關產能，以因應需求增加。
不過，供給快速增加也成為下一階段的觀察重點。2028年先進封裝產能預估成長約50%，遠高於屆時CSP資本支出12%的增幅，顯示目前供應鏈仍在積極增加產能，但供給追趕需求的速度也正在加快。

paras_en: September 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Demand for advanced packaging driven by AI chips is expected to continue through 2028. Even though cloud service providers (CSPs) are slowing the growth of capital expenditures, advanced‑packaging capacity will still expand rapidly. Morgan Stanley’s latest estimate projects that total advanced‑packaging capacity will grow about 50% by 2028, clearly outpacing the roughly 12% increase in CSP capital spending over the same period.

The growth in demand comes not only from the ongoing expansion of AI servers but also from each chip using more advanced‑packaging capacity. As AI chip sizes increase and CPUs and network processors adopt advanced packaging more widely, the market’s need for packaging capacity could rise faster than overall data‑center capital expenditures.

ASICs are another source of demand. Development of custom AI chips remains strong, with new collaborations and inference applications continuously adding up, expanding advanced‑packaging demand from GPUs to ASICs, CPUs and network processors. Supply‑chain surveys show that TSMC (2330‑TW) and its partners are still scaling related capacity to meet the rising demand.

However, the rapid increase in supply also becomes a focal point for the next stage. The projected ~50% growth in advanced‑packaging capacity by 2028 far exceeds the anticipated 12% rise in CSP capital spending, indicating that the supply chain is actively adding capacity, but the pace at which supply catches up with demand is also accelerating.
