items.title: 防AI自主升級失控！OpenAI提安全新標準 聚焦對齊研究與RSI技術風險
items.title_en: OpenAI Sets New Safety Standards to Prevent Uncontrolled AI Self‑Upgrade, Focuses on Alignment Research and RSI Risks
paras: OpenAI周一(21日)公布一套針對尖端人工智慧(AI)開發安全與防護的建議，重點放在「對齊研究」(alignment research)，以及一項稱為「遞迴自我改進」(recursive self-improvement, RSI)的運算技術。
OpenAI在部落格文章中表示：「要安全的因應這項轉變，需要讓對齊研究跟上這些能力的發展速度，確保我們及其他業者開發的系統，持續與人類價值觀一致，並受到人類控制。」

OpenAI籲國際合作制定標準

OpenAI呼籲各國展開國際合作，共同制定先進AI標準，並建議在全球現有AI安全研究機構的工作基礎上進一步發展。
OpenAI表示，這些技術標準應聚焦於前沿AI模型與開發商，以及對自動化AI研究人員進行利益與風險管理，包括RSI。
RSI受到AI開發商關注，因其具有打造基礎模型的潛力，讓AI系統能夠在沒有人工介入的情況下自行升級。
但RSI領域的進展也引發部分科技人士的疑慮，擔心模型開發商可能失去對根本技術的控制，或無法充分考量AI系統日益複雜、並廣泛存在於網際網路後，可能產生的非預期後果。
OpenAI在部落格文章中表示：「完全自主的RSI目前尚未實現，我們不應追求這項技術，除非且直到它能夠以安全的方式實現。如果沒有適當的重視與謹慎，RSI可能導致人類失去對AI開發的實際控制，甚至無法對自己已無法理解的研究流程進行監督。」

Hugging Face事件成風險預演

OpenAI的文章也提到Hugging Face遭AI代理程式駭入的事件。該事件並未涉及RSI技術，但OpenAI認為，這可視為未來若缺乏強健防護措施與對齊機制時，相關風險可能大幅加劇的預演。
競爭對手Anthropic上周也提出前沿AI模型安全開發的相關構想，回應近期業界研究人員接連對AI可能威脅人類的警告。
曾任職於Anthropic與OpenAI的Jacob Coxon在約兩周前宣布辭職，他當時表示，這些公司正在「拿我們的生命下注」，當時引發全球熱烈討論。在近期一連串與AI相關的資安事件，以及Coxon公開發表看法後，Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)發表文章，呼籲AI公司放慢基礎模型開發速度，並提出其他安全措施。
阿莫戴也提出讓第三方評估機構進駐AI公司的構想，以審查並降低相關技術可能對社會造成的風險，例如加速資安駭客攻擊，或協助製造生物武器。
OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)，以及SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克等競爭對手陣營的領導人，也公開支持阿莫戴的提議。

AI安全評估標準仍未形成共識

不過，由於AI評估領域仍處於非常早期的階段，目前尚未形成統一共識，也沒有無一套基本標準與原則，能讓獨立第三方比目前更深入地檢視。
這也是AI評估機構聯盟呼籲基礎模型開發商考慮一套「最低條件」的部分原因，目的是讓評估機構能更深入執行技術稽核與檢查，包括取得更深層的系統存取權，以及避免因發布不利報告而遭報復。
paras_en: OpenAI announced on Monday (21st) a set of recommendations for the safety and protection of cutting‑edge artificial intelligence (AI) development, emphasizing "alignment research" and a computational technique called "recursive self‑improvement" (RSI).

In its blog post, OpenAI stated: "To safely respond to this shift, alignment research must keep pace with the development of these capabilities, ensuring that systems we and other industry players develop remain aligned with human values and under human control."
OpenAI calls for international cooperation to establish advanced AI standards, suggesting further development built on the work of existing global AI safety research institutions.
OpenAI said these technical standards should focus on frontier AI models and developers, and on managing the benefits and risks for automated AI researchers, including RSI.
RSI has attracted attention from AI developers because of its potential to build foundational models that allow AI systems to upgrade themselves without human intervention.

However, progress in the RSI field has also raised concerns among some technologists, who worry that model developers may lose control over the underlying technology or fail to fully consider the unintended consequences that could arise as AI systems become increasingly complex and widely present on the internet.

In its blog post, OpenAI wrote: "Fully autonomous RSI has not yet been realized; we should not pursue this technology unless and until it can be implemented safely. Without proper attention and caution, RSI could cause humans to lose practical control over AI development, or even be unable to supervise research processes that we cannot understand."

The OpenAI article also mentioned the Hugging Face incident involving an AI agent hack. Although the incident did not involve RSI technology, OpenAI views it as a rehearsal of how risks could be greatly amplified in the future if robust protective measures and alignment mechanisms are lacking.
Last week, competitor Anthropic also proposed ideas for the safe development of frontier AI models, responding to recent warnings from industry researchers about AI potentially threatening humanity.

Jacob Coxon, who had worked at both Anthropic and OpenAI, announced his resignation about two weeks ago, stating that these companies were "betting our lives" on the technology, sparking global debate. Following a series of recent AI‑related cybersecurity incidents and Coxon's public statements, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published an article urging AI companies to slow the pace of foundational model development and propose additional safety measures.

Amodei also suggested bringing third‑party evaluation bodies into AI companies to review and reduce the potential societal risks of the technology, such as accelerating cyber‑hacking or aiding the creation of biological weapons.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, and other leaders from competing camps publicly supported Amodei's proposal.

However, because the AI evaluation field is still in its very early stages, there is no unified consensus or a set of basic standards and principles that would allow independent third parties to examine more deeply than currently possible.

This is also one of the reasons the AI Evaluation Alliance calls on foundational model developers to consider a "minimum set of conditions," aiming to enable evaluation bodies to conduct more thorough technical audits and inspections, including gaining deeper system access and avoiding retaliation for publishing unfavorable reports.

items.title: 1450億美元AI豪賭開始兌現？Muse成Meta消費市場突破口
items.title_en: $145 Billion AI Bet Starts Paying Off? Muse Becomes Meta's Consumer Market Breakthrough
paras: Meta平台(META-US) 本月推出的個人AI代理Muse迅速竄紅，下載量超越OpenAI的ChatGPT。這波熱度不僅帶動Meta股價單日大漲逾11%，也讓市場首度看見，Meta今年最高1,450億美元的AI資本支出，可能透過消費級產品轉化為實際回報。
Muse於本月8日在美國上線，定位並非單純回答問題的聊天機器人，而是能代替使用者執行多步驟任務的個人AI代理。
它可查詢不同帳戶中的資訊、填寫網頁表單、預訂行程、安排約會、發送郵件與訊息，甚至協助完成部分線上購物。使用者除了可透過獨立應用程式操作，也能從WhatsApp進入。
富國銀行分析師高雷爾斯基（Ken Gawrelski）認為，Muse等產品反映消費AI正從聊天機器人走向個人助理，AI不再只生成文字，而是開始代表使用者採取行動。
Muse的下載表現迅速反映在股價上。Meta周一(21日)大漲11.43%，收在741.24美元，9月累計漲幅接近30%，逼近今年1月以來最高收盤水準。
此前，投資人持續擔憂Meta的AI支出過於龐大，Muse則讓市場第一次看到，消費端產品有機會直接承接這些投資。
Meta今年預計資本支出達1,300億至1,450億美元，主要投入資料中心與AI基礎設施。儘管傳統廣告業務依然強勁，但大規模新增算力能否形成獨立收入來源，一直缺乏直觀證明。
如今Muse不只在下載榜超越ChatGPT，也建立更明確的收費模式，基礎版本免費，進階方案月費分別為20美元與100美元，有望將AI使用量轉化為經常性收入。
Meta也同步建立其他AI變現管道。公司上周推出Meta One，在分階段上線期間已累積1,500萬份訂閱與試用；另推出Model API，首度向開發者與企業收費開放底層模型能力。
Muse面向消費者，Meta One涵蓋既有社群產品，Model API則連結企業與開發者，三條路徑讓AI收入來源從廣告延伸至不同付費場景。
Meta龐大的使用者規模，更是Muse擴張的關鍵優勢。截至6月30日，包括Instagram、Facebook與WhatsApp在內的應用程式家族，日活躍用戶達36億人。
Muse若能嵌入這些平台，就不必從零建立分發管道，這是其他須獨立爭取下載量與使用時間的AI產品難以比擬的條件。
不過，Muse要真正成為交易型代理，仍須跨過第三方平台這一關。個人代理若要完成購物、旅遊與郵件等任務，必須存取使用者經常使用的網站，其能力愈強，也愈依賴外部平台是否願意開放。
亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 已要求Meta將其購物平台從Muse體驗中移除，並指Meta事前未告知Muse將存取Amazon商店，也未獲授權。Amazon同時對帳戶資料抓取與敏感資訊處理提出疑問，主張第三方AI應保持透明，並尊重平台是否參與的決定。
Meta則表示，Muse無法看到使用者密碼或付款資訊，憑證會被安全保存，代理可在不查看內容的情況下使用。
雙方立場差異顯示，當AI從回答問題跨入實際交易，平台授權與資料存取邊界也將成為新戰場。
Meta年度Connect大會將於當地時間周三登場，市場預期公司可能公布更多Muse使用數據與新功能。
當最高1,450億美元的資本支出已成投資人焦點，活躍用戶、訂閱轉換率與任務完成能力，將是檢驗Meta這場AI豪賭能否真正兌現的關鍵指標。
paras_en: Meta's platform (META-US) launched its personal AI agent Muse this month, quickly going viral and surpassing OpenAI's ChatGPT in downloads. The hype not only drove Meta's stock up more than 11% in a single day, but also gave the market its first glimpse that Meta's up to $145 billion AI capital spend this year could be turned into real returns through consumer products.
Muse went live in the United States on the 8th of this month, positioned not as a simple question‑answer chatbot but as a personal AI agent that can perform multi‑step tasks on behalf of users.

It can pull information from different accounts, fill out web forms, book trips, schedule appointments, send emails and messages, and even help complete parts of online shopping. Users can operate it via a standalone app or access it through WhatsApp.
Wells Fargo analyst Ken Gawrelski said products like Muse show consumer AI moving from chatbots to personal assistants, with AI no longer just generating text but actually taking actions for users.

Muse's download surge quickly reflected in the stock price. Meta jumped 11.43% on Monday (the 21st), closing at $741.24, up nearly 30% for September and approaching its highest closing level since January this year.
Previously, investors had been worried that Meta's AI spending was too large; Muse gave the market its first view that consumer‑facing products could directly capture those investments.

Meta expects capital expenditures of $130 billion to $145 billion this year, mainly for data centers and AI infrastructure. While traditional ad revenue remains strong, there has been no clear proof that the massive new compute capacity can generate an independent revenue stream.

Now Muse not only tops the download charts over ChatGPT but also has a clearer monetisation model: a free basic version and premium plans priced at $20 and $100 per month, potentially turning AI usage into recurring revenue.

Meta is also building other AI monetisation channels. Last week the company rolled out Meta One, which has already amassed 15 million subscriptions and trials during its phased launch, and introduced a Model API, opening access to underlying model capabilities to developers and enterprises for the first time with a fee.

Muse targets consumers, Meta One bundles existing social products, and the Model API connects with enterprises and developers, creating three pathways that extend AI revenue from advertising into various paid scenarios.
Meta's massive user base is a key advantage for Muse's expansion. As of June 30, the family of apps—including Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp—had 3.6 billion daily active users.

If Muse can be embedded across these platforms, it doesn’t need to build distribution channels from scratch, a condition that other AI products that must earn downloads and usage time on their own cannot match.

However, for Muse to become a truly transactional agent it must clear the hurdle of third‑party platforms. A personal agent that completes shopping, travel or email tasks needs access to the websites users frequently use, and the more capable it is, the more it depends on whether external platforms are willing to open up.

Amazon (AMZN-US) has asked Meta to remove its shopping platform from the Muse experience, claiming Meta did not inform Amazon that Muse would access the Amazon store and that no authorization was given. Amazon also raised concerns about account data scraping and handling of sensitive information, insisting that third‑party AI should remain transparent and respect a platform's decision to participate.
Meta responded that Muse cannot see users' passwords or payment details; credentials are stored securely, and the agent can operate without viewing the content.
The differing positions highlight that as AI moves from answering questions to actual transactions, platform permissions and data‑access boundaries will become a new battleground.
Meta's annual Connect conference will take place on Wednesday local time, and the market expects the company may reveal more Muse usage data and new features.

With up to $145 billion in capital spending now a focal point for investors, active users, subscription conversion rates and task‑completion capability will be the key metrics to judge whether Meta's AI gamble truly pays off.

items.title_en: Global Bond Market Roars with Sell‑offs! US Treasuries Fail to Rank in Top Four as Four Countries Sell Even More Aggressively
paras: 全球長債掀起新一波拋售潮。美國10年期公債殖利率過去一年上升97個基點，上週盤中更突破5%，但升幅仍排不進主要經濟體前四名，落後韓國、日本、澳洲及法國，顯示全球長期資金成本正攀向數十年高點。
10年期美債殖利率上週一度升至5.04%，創2007年以來最高水準，隨後雖然回落，仍引發市場高度關注。這也是自2023年10月殖利率短暫急升以來，這項被視為「全球資產定價之錨」的指標首度重返5%上方。
不過，這次債市動盪並非美國「獨舞」。依Visual Capitalist整理的數據，過去一年韓國10年期公債殖利率狂升178個基點，居主要經濟體之首；日本上升145個基點，澳洲與法國則分別增加114個及102個基點，均高於美國的97個基點。
韓日澳法殖利率升幅超越美國
日本債市的變化格外受到矚目。隨著市場預期日本央行將進一步收緊貨幣政策，日本10年期公債殖利率本月睽違30年首度突破3%，顯示維持數十年的超低利率環境正出現重大轉變。殖利率走高，也可能進一步加重日本原已沉重的政府債務負擔。
拋售壓力同樣席捲歐洲。德國10年期公債殖利率上週升至2009年以來高點，英國長期借貸成本則跨越5%門檻。法國面臨的壓力更為突出，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差上週擴大至100個基點，為2012年以來首見。
法國財政預算疑慮是利差擴大的主要原因。法國政府在未能達成2026年目標後，計畫削減預算，但立法層面能否取得妥協仍不明朗，明年總統大選也增添不確定性。
四大因素推升長債殖利率
Visual Capitalist分析師Dorothy Neufeld指出，在油價上漲、通膨黏性及政府舉債需求激增等因素夾擊下，全球主要經濟體公債殖利率正全面且明顯走高。
這波長債拋售背後，還包括能源價格帶來的再通膨疑慮、居高不下的財政赤字、AI發債潮下的資金競爭，以及投資人不願再對長端風險溢價讓步。
公債殖利率是整體信用資產與借貸成本的重要定價基準，一旦長端利率大幅上移，房貸、企業發債與各類信貸融資成本都將變得更昂貴，進而壓抑投資與消費。
對債務水準偏高的已開發經濟體而言，公債展期與利息支出也會隨之增加，讓財政空間進一步收窄。
高殖利率也直接衝擊股票等風險資產。當10年期美債殖利率徘徊在5%左右，投資人可從相對安全的政府公債取得更高報酬，股票因而面臨更高的報酬門檻，全球基金經理人目前已普遍將債市動盪列為首要市場風險。
國泰君安國際首席經濟學家周浩表示，過去20多年，市場相信經濟承壓時，央行最終會透過降息壓低融資成本，長期利率也將回落。
然而，當前債市傳遞的訊號正挑戰這項共識，市場關注焦點已從「下一次降息何時到來」，逐步轉向「政府持續擴張的債務最終由誰承擔」。
paras_en: Global long‑term bonds have sparked a new wave of sell‑offs. The yield on the U.S. 10‑year Treasury rose 97 basis points over the past year and broke the 5% mark during intraday trading last week, yet the increase still lagged behind the top four major economies, trailing South Korea, Japan, Australia and France, indicating that global long‑term funding costs are climbing toward multi‑decade highs.

The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield briefly jumped to 5.04% on Monday, the highest level since 2007. Although it later retreated, the move drew intense market attention. It also marked the first time since a brief surge in October 2023 that this benchmark, regarded as the “anchor for global asset pricing,” has risen above 5% again.

However, this bond‑market turbulence is not a solo performance by the United States. According to data compiled by Visual Capitalist, South Korea’s 10‑year sovereign yield surged 178 basis points over the past year—the highest among major economies; Japan’s rose 145 basis points, while Australia’s and France’s increased by 114 and 102 basis points respectively, all outpacing the U.S.’s 97‑basis‑point gain.
South Korea, Japan, Australia and France see yield gains that surpass the United States.

Japan’s bond market changes are drawing particular attention. With market expectations that the Bank of Japan will tighten policy further, Japan’s 10‑year sovereign yield broke the 3% threshold this month for the first time in 30 years, signalling a major shift away from decades of ultra‑low rates. Higher yields could also add to Japan’s already heavy sovereign debt burden.

Sell‑off pressure is also sweeping Europe. Germany’s 10‑year sovereign yield rose to its highest level since 2009 last week, while the United Kingdom’s long‑term borrowing costs crossed the 5% barrier. France faces even sharper pressure, as the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 100 basis points last week—the first such widening since 2012.

Fiscal budget concerns in France are the main driver of the widening spread. After failing to meet its 2026 target, the French government plans to cut its budget, but it remains unclear whether legislative compromise can be reached, and the upcoming presidential election next year adds further uncertainty.
Four major factors are pushing long‑term yields higher

Visual Capitalist analyst Dorothy Neufeld points out that a combination of rising oil prices, sticky inflation and a surge in government borrowing demand are driving sovereign yields up across the world’s major economies.

Behind this wave of long‑bond sell‑offs are worries about re‑inflation from energy prices, persistently high fiscal deficits, funding competition amid an AI‑driven debt‑issuance boom, and investors’ reluctance to concede risk premiums on the long end.

Sovereign yields are a key pricing benchmark for overall credit assets and borrowing costs; when long‑end rates climb sharply, mortgage rates, corporate bond issuance and various credit financing become more expensive, which in turn dampens investment and consumption.
For developed economies with relatively high debt levels, longer‑dated debt and interest‑payment obligations will also rise, further tightening fiscal space.

High yields also directly hit risk assets such as equities. When the 10‑year U.S. Treasury hovers around 5%, investors can obtain higher returns from relatively safe government bonds, raising the return hurdle for stocks. Global fund managers now generally rank bond‑market turbulence as the top market risk.

Guotai Junan International chief economist Zhou Hao said that over the past two decades, markets have believed that when the economy is under pressure, central banks will ultimately cut rates to lower financing costs, and long‑term rates will fall back.

However, the current signals from the bond market are challenging that consensus; market focus has shifted from “when the next rate cut will come” to “who will ultimately bear the burden of governments’ ever‑expanding debt.”

paras_en: Benefiting from a sharp fall in international oil prices, robust South Korean export data and inflows of foreign capital, the Korean won surged significantly against the US dollar on Tuesday (the 22nd). The one‑day gain briefly widened to 1.5%, reaching 1,352.90 won per dollar, marking the largest single‑day rise in five weeks and far outpacing other Asian currencies.

Market data showed the won opened at 1,371 per dollar, about 0.67% higher than the previous close. The rate then quickly broke the 1,360‑won barrier. Analysts noted that with the Mid‑Autumn holiday approaching, major South Korean exporters were selling dollars en masse, while foreign investors were buying South Korean stocks and US equities rebounded strongly, boosting overall market risk appetite.

On the geopolitical front, signs of dialogue emerged between the US and Iran, and international oil prices fell for three consecutive days. Brent crude futures dropped 3.4% to $100.34 a barrel, and West Texas Intermediate slid 4.5% below the $100 mark, providing a boost to both equity markets and the won exchange market.

South Korea reported on Monday that export value for the first 20 days of September rose 78% year‑on‑year, with semiconductor shipments surging 259%, bringing in a massive inflow of US dollars. At the same time, dollar buying pressure eased and the yield on the US 10‑year Treasury fell below 5%, relieving upward pressure on the dollar.

Woori Bank analyst Min Gyeong‑won said that the revival of risk appetite benefits exporters who convert earnings and sell dollars, further pushing the won lower. However, the global high‑interest‑rate environment and the overall strength of the dollar could still limit the won’s upside potential.

U.S. August manufacturing output unexpectedly fell month‑on‑month. Rising oil prices and higher rates may outweigh AI‑driven support, keeping manufacturing activity modest for the rest of the year. Meanwhile the market hopes diplomatic breakthroughs on the Iran war during this week’s UN session, and Saudi oil shipments have partially resumed despite ongoing Houthi attacks in Yemen, pushing oil prices down and reducing dollar‑safe‑haven buying. In addition, the Bank of Japan raised rates to 1.25% as expected last Monday, but two board members voted against it and there was no clear hawkish guidance. Disappointed investors briefly pushed USD/JPY above 158, a two‑week high, before Japanese authorities reportedly queried the FX market and CFTC data showed net long yen positions surged to the highest level since July 2025 as of the week ending 15 Sept. items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至近8周高點 歐元因德國政局受矚
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Rises to Near 8‑Week High; Euro in Focus Over German Politics
paras: 美元周一(19日)小幅走升，來到近8周高點，延續上周強勁漲勢，此前聯準會(Fed)進行了 3年多來首次升息。另一方面，日元在日本銀行(BoJ)決定收緊貨幣政策後，先前一波猛烈跌勢暫歇，歐元則因德國最新民調結果出爐而受矚。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報100.43，創7月29日以來最高。
本月市場最受關注議題之一，就是各大央行的升息行動。歐洲銀行(ECB)、聯準會與日本銀行近期都採取升息措施，且都提到了能源價格推動的通膨壓力。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在記者會上表示，「明確的事實就是通膨太高，而且已經持續太久。」
此前，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至 3.75%-4.00%。
此外，聯準會更新後的「經濟預測摘要」顯示，至少有12名FOMC委員認為今年還會再升息一次。
在FOMC做出升息決定之前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率曾飆升至90%。推動市場預期的因素包括：油價急升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭到拋售。尤其是固定收益市場投資人對這次升息反應正面，因他們認為這顯示聯準會沒有在通膨問題上落後於形勢。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資長Brent Schutte表示，「經濟的強勁表現，很可能就是聯準會認為可以升息的原因。但我們也提醒，升息的目的就是要放慢經濟成長速度。因此也會提高政策過度緊縮的風險，因為升息對經濟的影響延遲且不均。」
他進一步表示，「你們或許還記得，聯準會上一輪在2022年和2023年的升息，造成了經濟出現明顯分化。」當時，對利率較敏感的產業、企業及消費者面臨較大壓力，即使整體經濟仍持續成長。
歐元承受德國政治局勢轉變壓力
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1歐元兌1.1463 美元。
歐洲交易市場正在消化周末公布的選舉預測結果。結果顯示，極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」(AfD)在德國東北部的州選舉中取得領先。
這項具歷史意義的結果，直接打擊了德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的主流保守派聯盟，也讓歐洲股市面臨新的政治風險。
德銀的Jim Reid表示，「在極右派方面，AfD持續獲得更多支持，主要訴求包括反移民與反建制，尤其是在德國東部地區。」他也指出，左派政黨似乎則成功利用了民眾對住房負擔能力、生活成本以及社會不平等的擔憂。
他補充，「對市場而言，眼前最直接的影響並不是德國國家政策會立刻改變，而是德國政治中心進一步弱化，也再次提醒市場，推動歐洲政治兩極化的力量仍然存在。」
日元在升息、「利率檢查」後走弱
日元周一走弱，延續上周約2%猛烈跌勢。此前日銀公布利率決策後，日元跌至數周低點。
美元兌日元上漲0.3%，來到157.36日元。
日本金融市場周一因三天國定假期而休市。
由於假期期間流動性較低，全球交易員高度警戒日本政府可能進行外匯干預。過去在市場流動性不足的情況下，央行進場買進本國貨幣可能造成更大的價格波動。
讓市場對干預的擔憂進一步升高的是，《日本經濟新聞》上周五報導，日銀曾進行所謂的 「利率檢查」。這是指央行官員打電話給外匯交易部門，詢問市場上實際的買賣價。
日本銀行上周五將借貸成本提高至1.25%，創下31年來最高水準。
然而，兩名委員投下偏寬鬆政策的反對票，加上日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)強調政策需要進行預先性的調整，最初反而引發市場「利多出盡」反應。
這也迫使日本當局開始採取更積極的口頭警告及「利率檢查」，以支撐日元匯率。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Monday (the 19th), reaching a near‑8‑week high and continuing last week’s strong rally after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years. Meanwhile, the yen’s sharp slide eased after the Bank of Japan tightened policy, and the euro drew attention following the release of Germany’s latest poll results.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 100.43, its highest level since July 29.

One of the market’s top topics this month is the rate‑hike actions of major central banks. The European Central Bank, the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan have all recently raised rates and all cited inflation pressure from energy prices.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at a press conference last week that “the clear fact is that inflation is too high and has been too persistent.”
Earlier, the Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to lift the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%.
In addition, the Fed’s updated Summary of Economic Projections showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year.

Before the FOMC’s decision, market expectations for a Fed hike had surged to 90%. Drivers of that expectation included a sharp rise in oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling. Fixed‑income investors reacted positively, seeing the hike as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation pressures.

Brent Schutte, Chief Investment Officer at Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management, said, “The economy’s strong performance is likely why the Fed feels it can raise rates. But we remind that the purpose of tightening is to slow growth, which raises the risk of overtightening because the impact of rate hikes is delayed and uneven.”

He added, “You may recall the Fed’s previous tightening cycles in 2022‑2023 caused a clear split in the economy.” At that time, rate‑sensitive industries, firms and consumers felt heightened pressure even as overall growth continued.
Euro Under Pressure From Shifts in German Politics
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1463 per euro.
European markets are digesting the election‑forecast results released over the weekend, which showed the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD) leading in state elections in Germany’s northeast.
The historic outcome directly hit the mainstream conservative Union bloc led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz and added new political risk to European equities.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, “On the far‑right, the AfD is gaining more support, driven mainly by anti‑immigration and anti‑establishment messages, especially in eastern Germany.” He also noted that left‑wing parties seem to be capitalising on public concerns about housing affordability, living costs and social inequality.

He added, “For markets, the most immediate impact isn’t an immediate change in German national policy, but a further weakening of Germany’s political centre, reminding investors that forces driving European political polarisation remain present.”
Yen Weakens After Rate Hike and “Rate Check”
The yen weakened on Monday, extending last week’s roughly 2% plunge. Earlier, the yen fell to a multi‑week low after the BOJ announced its rate decision.
The dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to 157.36 yen.
Japan’s financial markets were closed on Monday for a three‑day national holiday.

Because liquidity is thin during the holiday, global traders are on high alert for possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government. In past low‑liquidity episodes, central‑bank purchases of the domestic currency have amplified price swings.

Market worries about intervention were heightened after Nikkei reported last Friday that the BOJ had carried out a so‑called “rate check,” meaning officials called FX desks to ask about actual bid‑ask prices in the market.
The Bank of Japan raised its borrowing cost to 1.25% last Friday, the highest level in 31 years.

However, two board members cast votes for a more accommodative stance, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policy needed a pre‑emptive adjustment, initially prompting a “no‑more‑good‑news” reaction in the market.
That forced Japanese authorities to adopt more aggressive verbal warnings and conduct “rate checks” to support the yen’s exchange rate.

items.title: 日本救日元反成賣點！瑞銀資管等再度干預伺機賣出
items.title_en: Japan's Yen Rescue Becomes a Selling Point! UBS Asset Management and Others May Intervene Again to Sell
paras: 瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，若日本政府再度出手干預匯市、拉抬日元，將是賣出日元的好機會。他並不認為日銀上周五升息，意味貨幣政策已明顯轉向鷹派。
Zhao今年稍早原本加碼持有日元，但在美日兩國7月大規模聯手買進日元後賣出部位，如今正等待下一次進場賣出的時機。當時日元兌美元一度貶至約164日元，創40年來最低水準。
日銀上周升息，並宣告貨幣政策已進入「新階段」，但Zhao認為，無論是進一步升息或政府再次干預，都不足以讓投資人相信日元能夠持續走強。他直言，日本維持弱勢日元的根本政策並未改變，美元兌日元接下來可能繼續攀升，日本當局最終仍會再度干預，否則恐怕顏面盡失。
日元本月初一度因市場預期日銀將加快升息而反彈，但上周五升息後支撐有限，匯價再度朝164日元關卡靠近。日本當局隨後向市場參與者進行匯率「詢價」，這項行動通常被視為正式進場買進日元的前兆。
目前交易員押注日銀至明年6月最多還會升息3次，但也預期聯準會(Fed)同期將升息相同次數，意味美日利差未必明顯縮小。Zhao反問，若Fed降息期間美元兌日元都未能大幅回落，如今Fed轉向升息，日元又怎麼可能顯著升值？
Zhao預期，即使日本通膨隨經濟成長升溫，日銀未來幾個月仍會放慢緊縮腳步。日本首相高市早苗延續前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」路線，堅持透過財政支出支撐經濟。在股市大漲、名目國內生產毛額(GDP)成長及政府債務龐大的情況下，低利率仍符合政府與日銀利益。他強調，「安倍經濟學從來不等於強勢日元」。
paras_en: UBS Asset Management’s global sovereign and currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao said that if the Japanese government intervenes again in the FX market to prop up the yen, it would be a good opportunity to sell the yen. He does not believe that the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last Friday signals a clear hawkish shift in monetary policy.

Zhao had increased his yen holdings earlier this year, but sold those positions after the United States and Japan jointly bought large amounts of yen in July. He is now waiting for the next chance to re‑enter and sell. At that time the yen fell to about ¥164 per dollar, its lowest level in 40 years.

The BOJ raised rates last week and announced that monetary policy had entered a “new stage,” but Zhao thinks that whether the BOJ hikes further or the government intervenes again, neither will convince investors that the yen can stay strong. He bluntly says Japan’s fundamental policy of keeping a weak yen has not changed, the dollar‑yen pair may keep climbing, and the authorities will eventually intervene again or risk losing face.

The yen briefly rebounded earlier this month on expectations that the BOJ would accelerate rate hikes, but the support faded after the Friday hike and the exchange rate moved back toward the ¥164 level. Japanese authorities then sent a “price inquiry” to market participants, an action usually seen as a prelude to officially buying yen.

Traders currently bet that the BOJ may raise rates up to three more times by June next year, while also expecting the Fed to raise rates the same number of times, meaning the US‑Japan rate differential may not narrow much. Zhao retorts that if the dollar‑yen pair did not fall significantly during the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle, how could the yen appreciate markedly now that the Fed is back to tightening?

Zhao expects that even if Japanese inflation rises with economic growth, the BOJ will slow its tightening over the next few months. Prime Minister Kishida continues former Prime Minister Abe’s “Abenomics” approach, insisting on fiscal spending to support the economy. With a booming stock market, nominal GDP growth and massive government debt, low rates still suit both the government and the BOJ. He stresses that “Abenomics has never meant a strong yen.”

items.title: 南韓央行啟動24小時韓元交割網路試點
items.title_en: South Korea's Central Bank Launches 24-Hour Won Settlement Network Pilot
paras: 南韓中央銀行(BOK)周一(21日)正式啟動首個24小時韓元交割網路的試營運。此系統於當地時間周一上午9點開始運行，首波由國民銀行(KB Kookmin)、友利銀行(Woori)、韓亞銀行(Hana)與新韓銀行(Shinhan)等四家南韓本土商業銀行率先參與。
在開運首晨約9點30分，兩家參試本土機構成功完成首筆測試交易，金額約為14億韓元(約合100萬美元)。
這項全天候交割機制在工作日實行24小時不間斷運作，僅在周末與國定假日休市。其最大特色在於允許境外外國投資人透過「韓元業務註冊外國機構」(RFI-K)開設的帳戶，在其所在地的當地營業時間直接辦理韓元交易結算與交割，無須親自在南韓境內金融機構開立帳戶。
此舉顯著改善了過去歐美投資人因時差問題而面臨的債券與資產交割延宕困境。
此次試營運為南韓政府推動「韓元國際化路線圖」及外匯改革計畫的重要推手。先前南韓在岸韓元對美元外匯市場已於7月邁入全天候交易，本次交割網路補足了配套支付基礎設施，旨在提升韓元的國際地位，並積極爭取納入 MSCI 發達市場指數。
這一網路預計經約3個月測試後，於2027年1月正式上線營運，屆時將擴大邀請全球主要外資銀行及金融機構全面接入。
paras_en: South Korea's central bank (BOK) officially launched the pilot operation of its first 24‑hour won settlement network on Monday (the 21st). The system began running at 9:00 a.m. local time, with four domestic commercial banks – KB Kookmin, Woori, Hana and Shinhan – participating in the initial wave.

Around 9:30 a.m. on the first morning of operation, two of the participating domestic institutions successfully completed the first test transaction, amounting to roughly 1.4 billion won (about US$1 million).

The round‑the‑clock settlement mechanism operates continuously 24 hours on business days, closing only on weekends and public holidays. Its key feature is that foreign investors can settle and deliver won transactions directly during their own local business hours through accounts opened via the "Registered Foreign Institution for Won Business" (RFI‑K), without needing to open an account at a Korean financial institution.
This move markedly eases the bond and asset settlement delays that European and U.S. investors previously faced due to time‑zone differences.

The pilot supports South Korea's government push for a "Won Internationalisation Roadmap" and foreign‑exchange reform, following the launch of all‑day on‑shore won‑USD trading in July. The new settlement network adds the necessary payment infrastructure to boost the won's global standing and to help secure inclusion in the MSCI Developed Markets index.

The network is expected to undergo about three months of testing before going live in January 2027, at which point it will invite major global foreign banks and financial institutions to connect fully.

items.title: 升息失望與干預疑慮交織 日元在連假流動性低迷下恐加劇波動
items.title_en: Rate Hike Disappointment and Intervention Concerns Intertwine, Yen May See Heightened Volatility Amid Low Liquidity During Holiday
paras: 日元對美元在上周重挫逾2%後，於周一(21日)盤初暫告企穩，報156.85日元兌1美元。然而，隨著日本「白銀周」到來，交易員擔心，在市場流動性大幅下降後，恐加劇匯率波動。
日本央行上周五雖然將政策利率調升至1.25%，創下31年來新高，然而會中出現2票反對，加上總裁植田和男並未提供明確的未來升息指引，使寄望鷹派立場的投資人感到失望，引發日元走跌，盤中一度下挫1.3%。
隨後市場傳出日本官方進行「匯率檢查」(rate check)，雖稍微收斂跌幅並收於156.88日元，但依然凸顯出匯市強烈的干預疑慮與風險。
目前，日本正逢「白銀周」連續休假，市場交易流動性大幅下降，投資人對官方干預保持高度戒備。分析指出，流動性較低時易引發劇烈波動，但也為當局介入提供放大效果的契機，一如今年4月至5月黃金周期間日元跌破160關卡後的干預舉措。
財務省數據顯示，日本當局於7月下旬至8月26日期間，曾砸下創紀錄的15.4兆日元進行美日協調干預，帶動日元從7月接近164的40年低點，一度強勢反彈至9月初的152.89高峰。
然而，美日央行政策分歧再次為日元帶來下行壓力。聯準會近期發出鷹派訊號，市場預計10月繼續升息的機率升至55%；反觀日央行10月升息的機率，已被掉期市場定價降至20%以下。
監管數據顯示，投機客在日央行會前將日元淨多頭部位推升至97億美元(創2025年7月以來新高)。但在日央行政策指引缺乏明確鷹派訊號的情況下，這批多頭押注正面臨極大回檔風險。
paras_en: The yen slipped more than 2% against the dollar last week, but on Monday (the 21st) it briefly steadied in early trade at 156.85 yen per $1.

Although the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% last Friday – a 31‑year high – two votes were cast against the move and Governor Kazuo Ueda gave no clear guidance on future hikes, leaving investors who had hoped for a hawkish stance disappointed and sending the yen down, at one point falling 1.3% intraday.

Subsequently, reports emerged that Japanese authorities were conducting a “rate check,” which trimmed the decline slightly and closed at 156.88 yen, but the episode still underscored strong market fears of possible intervention.

Japan is currently in the middle of “Silver Week,” a string of holidays that has sharply reduced market liquidity, prompting investors to stay on high alert for official action. Analysts note that low‑liquidity environments can trigger sharp moves, yet they also give authorities a bigger impact if they choose to step in, as seen after the yen fell below the 160‑yen barrier during the gold‑price rally in April‑May this year.

Ministry of Finance data show that Japanese authorities intervened with a record‑breaking 15.4 trillion yen in coordinated US‑Japan action from late July to August 26, lifting the yen from near a 40‑year low of about 164 in July to a strong rebound of 152.89 in early September.

However, policy divergence between the Fed and the BOJ is again weighing on the yen. The Fed’s recent hawkish signals have pushed the market’s odds of another October hike to 55%, while the BOJ’s chance of an October hike has been priced by the swap market at below 20%.

Regulatory data indicate that speculators pushed net long positions on the yen to $9.7 billion ahead of the BOJ meeting – a high not seen since July 2025 – but with the BOJ offering no clear hawkish guidance, those long bets now face a substantial risk of a sharp unwind.

items.title: 川習會前夕中國人行放寬升值干預 人民幣匯率創逾3年半新高
items.title_en: China's Central Bank Eases RMB Appreciation Controls Ahead of Trump‑Xi Summit, RMB Hits Over 3‑Year‑Half High
paras: 在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平本周將舉行峰會之際，中國人民銀行放寬了對人民幣升值的限制，帶動人民幣對美元匯率於周一(21日)升至逾3年半以來的新高。
周一早盤，境內人民幣對美元一度觸及 6.6957，創下 2023 年 1 月 16 日以來的最高點；離岸人民幣升至 6.6946。
開盤前，中國人行將人民幣對美元中間價設在 6.7487，雖創下 2023 年 2 月 3 日以來的新高，但仍比《路透》調查的市場預測值弱了 536 個基點。
本次匯率走強適逢美中兩國高層密集會談。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與中國國務院副總理何立峰於周日在紐約結束會談，為川普與習近平預計於周四舉行的峰會鋪路。外界預期雙方將討論人工智慧、貿易關係、供應鏈及中東緊張局勢等議題，但分析師預估不會有重大政策突破。
針對人行近期縮小中間價與市場預期差距的舉措，高盛分析師在報告中表示，人行在川習會召開前調強中間價的作法符合近年歷史經驗，這為離岸人民幣現貨價格進一步走強創造了更大空間。
華僑銀行(OCBC)則在報告中指出，較強且相對穩定的人民幣有助於為美中談判創造更有建設性的背景，並減少美方再度指責競爭性貶值的可能性。
然而，華僑銀行也表示，不應將此視為人民幣長期升值周期的開始，並指出：「鑑於美中兩國之間龐大的利差以及中國國內依然疲軟的基本面，近期部分升值可能僅反映了峰會期間由政策維護的穩定性，而非人民幣基本面的重新估值。」
paras_en: As U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping prepare to hold a summit this week, the People’s Bank of China has loosened restrictions on RMB appreciation, pushing the RMB‑USD exchange rate up to a new high not seen in over three and a half years on Monday (the 21st).
In early trade on Monday, the onshore RMB briefly touched 6.6957 per dollar, the highest level since Jan. 16, 2023, while offshore RMB rose to 6.6946.
Before the market opened, the PBOC set the RMB‑USD midpoint at 6.7487, a fresh peak since Feb. 3, 2023, yet still 53.6 basis points weaker than the market forecast gathered by Reuters.

The currency rally comes amid intensive high‑level talks between the United States and China. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice‑Premier He Lifeng concluded talks in New York on Sunday, paving the way for the Trump‑Xi summit slated for Thursday. Observers expect discussions on AI, trade, supply chains and Middle‑East tensions, though analysts doubt any major policy breakthroughs will emerge.

Commenting on the PBOC’s recent narrowing of the gap between the midpoint and market expectations, a Goldman Sachs analyst said that strengthening the midpoint ahead of the summit follows historical patterns and creates more room for offshore RMB spot prices to rise further.

OCBC Bank noted in its report that a stronger and relatively stable RMB helps create a more constructive backdrop for U.S.–China negotiations and reduces the likelihood of the U.S. accusing China of competitive devaluation again.

However, OCBC cautioned that this should not be seen as the start of a long‑term RMB appreciation cycle, stating: “Given the large interest‑rate differential between the United States and China and still‑weak domestic fundamentals in China, the recent modest appreciation may simply reflect policy‑backed stability during the summit period rather than a fundamental re‑valuation of the RMB.”
